shes rab sna tshogs/ (k+ṣi (34)0030 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sdud pa tshigs su bcad pa/ 3rgya gar gyi mkhan po biṅgā ka ra sing ha dang /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(45) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(53)0031 'phags pa rab kyi rtsal gyis rnam par gnon pas zhus pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bstan pa/ 54dang po/ gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 54gnyis pa/ kun dga' bo'i le'u/ 83gsum pa/ de bzhin nyid kyi le'u/ 92bzhi pa/ dpe'i le'u/ 117lnga pa/ rab 'byor gyi le'u/ 1551

drug pa/ spyod pa'i le'u/ 163bdun pa/ phan yon gyi le'u/ 217rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī len dra bo snyi dang /dzi na mi tra dang /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(252) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(278)0032 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa lnga brgya pa/ 279bsdur mchan/(321) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(326)0033 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rdo rje gcod pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 327bsdur mchan/(358) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(363)0034 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul brgya lnga bcu pa/ 364bsdur mchan/(381) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(383)0035 'phags pa bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa lnga bcu pa/ 384bsdur mchan/(390) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(391)2

0036 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa kau shi ka zhes bya ba/392bsdur mchan/(396) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(397)0037 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo nyi shu rtsa lnga pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 398bsdur mchan/(401) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(401)0038 bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po/402rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi ma la mi tra dang /lots+tsha ba dge slong rin chen sdes bsgyur cing /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba dge blo dang nam mkha' la sogs pas zhus te gtan la phab/dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i/gtsug lag gi dge rgyas bye ma gling gi jig ngos la bris pa dang zhu dag legs pa bgyis/bsdur mchan/(406) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(407)0039 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yi ge nyung ngu zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 408bsdur mchan/(412) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(413)0040 de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma yi ge gcig ma zhes bya ba/ 414

bsdur mchan/(415) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(416)0041 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bdun brgya pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 417bsdur mchan/(481) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(489)0042 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa zhes bya ba/ ga0bsdur mchan/(495) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(496)0043 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyi ma'i snying po theg pa chen po'i mdo/ go7bsdur mchan/(501) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(502)0044 'phags pa zla ba'i snying po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 503bsdur mchan/(506) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(507)0045 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa kun tu bzang po theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 508

bsdur mchan/(510) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(510)0046 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa lag na rdo rje'i mdo theg pa chen po/ 511bsdur mchan/(513) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(513)0047 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi mdo theg pa chen po/ 514bsdur mchan/(516) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(516)0042 chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor ba'i mdo/ 517paṇ+ḍi ta chen po ā nan+da shrī'i zhal snga nas/ mang du thos pa'i lots+tsha ba shākya'i dge slong nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ skad gnyis smra ba rnams kyi gdan sa/ gtsug lag khang chen po dpal thar pa gling du bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(525) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(526)0049 skye/sa pa rabs kyi gleng gzhi/ 527ring ba'i gleng gzhi 'chad pa/ 527bar ma'i gleng gzhi 'chad pa/ 608nye ba'i gleng gzhi 'chad pa/ 6615

paṇ+ḍi ta ā nan+da shrī'i zhal snga nas/ mang du thos pa'i lots+tsha ba shākya'i dge slong nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ skad gnyis smra ba rnams kyi gdan sa/gtsug lag khang chen po dpal // pa gling du bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la bsdur mchan/(697 bsdur 'bras re'u mig(723)0050 lcang lo can gyi pho brang gi mdo/ 724lcang lo can gyi pho brang gi mdo las skabs rab mchog dang po 'chad pa/ 724lcang lo can gyi pho brang gi mdo las skabs rab mchog gnyis pa 'chad pa/ 735paṇ+ḍi ta ā nan+da shrī'i zhal snga nas/ mang du thos pa'i lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bos/ skad gnyis smra ba rnams kyi gdan sa/ gtsug lag khang chen po dpal // pa gling du bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la bsdur mchan/(748) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(752)0051 'dus pa chen po'i mdo/ 753paṇ+ḍi ta ā nan+da shrī'i zhal snga nas/ mang du thos pa'i lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ skad gnyis smra ba rnams kyi gdan sa/ gtsug lag khang chen po dpal thar pa gling du bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(762) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(7670052 byams pa'i mdo/ 7656

paṇ+ḍi ta ā nan+da shrī'i zhal snga nas/ mang du thos pa'i lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal zang pos/ skad gnyis smra ba rnams kyi gdan sa/ gtsug lag khang chen po dpal // pa gling du bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la bsdur mchan/(782) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(785)0053 byams pa bsgom pa'i mdo/ 786paṇ+ḍi ta chen po ā nan+da shrī'i zhal snga nas/ mang du thos pa'i lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ skad gnyis smra ba rnams kyi gdan sa/ gtsug lag khang chen po dpal thar pa gling du bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab bsdur mchan/(788) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(790)0054 bslab pa lnga'i phan yon gyi mdo/ 791paṇ+ḍi ta chen po ā nan+da shrī'i zhal snga nas/ mang du thos pa'i lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ skad gnyis smra ba rnams kyi gdan sa/ gtsug lag khang chen po dpal thar pa gling du bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(805) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(808)0055 ri'i kun dga' bo'i mdo/ 809paṇ+ḍi ta chen po ā nan+da shrī'i zhal snga nas/ mang du thos pa'i lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ skad gnyis smra ba 7

rnams kyi gdan sa/ gtsug lag khang chen po dpal thar pa gling du bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(816) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(818)0056 klu'i rgyal po dga' bo nyer dga' 'dul ba'i mdo/ 819paṇ+ḍi ta chen po ā nan+da shrī'i zhal snga nas/ mang du thos pa'i lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ skad gnyis smra ba rnams kyi gdan sa/ gtsug lag khang chen po tādīkā thar pa gling du bsgyur cing zhus te gtan bsdur mchan/(825) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(826)0057 'od sung chen po'i mdo/ 827paṇ+ḍi ta chen po ā nan+da shrī'i zhal snga nas/ mang du thos pa'i lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ skad gnyis smra ba rnams kyi gdan sa/ gtsug lag khang chen po tādīkā thar pa gling du bsgyur cing zhus te gtan bsdur mchan/(830) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(831)0058 nyi ma'i mdo/ 832paṇ+ḍi ta chen po ā nan+da shrī'i zhal snga nas/ mang du thos pa'i lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ skad gnyis smra ba rnams kyi gdan sa/ gtsug lag khang chen po tādīkā thar pa gling du bsgyur cing zhus te gtan

bsdur mchan/(837 bsdur 'bras re'u mig(835)0059 zla ba'i mdo/ 836paṇ+ḍi ta chen po ā nan+da shrī'i zhal snga nas/ mang du thos pa'i lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ skad gnyis smra ba rnams kyi gdan sa/ gtsug lag khang chen po tādīkā thar pa gling du bsgyur cing zhus te gtan bsdur mchan/(838) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(839)0060 bkra shis chen po'i mdo/ 840paṇ+ḍi ta ā nan+da shrī'i zhal snga nas/ mang du thos pa'i lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ skad gnyis smra ba rnams kyi gdan sa/ gtsug lag khang chen po dpal // pa gling du bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la bsdur mchan/(843) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(84spro

sdud pa tshigs su bcad pa/3ste༄tshog /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya pradzñā pā (ger mi tā lasañtsa ya gā bskyi/bod skad du/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sdud pa tshigs su bcad pal/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal dul phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor bzhi po de dag yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad pa'i phyir yang thoshes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ston cing / de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dgashebaka' stsal to/ /dga' dang gus dang dad pa'i mchog ni nyer bzhagasheste/ /sgrib pa nyon mongs bsal nas dri ma las 'das pa/ /ge'agro don mngon zhugs des pa'i shes rab pha rol phyin/ /gang la dpa' rnams spyod pa de ni mnyan par gyis/ / skabs dang po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid bstan/⑩ 'dzam bu'i nyu17gling 'dir chu klung ji snyed cig 'bab cing / /me tog 'bras ldan sman dang nags tshal skyed byed pa/ /ma dros gnas pa'i klu dbang klu bdag brten 34—3

gnas 1te/ /de ni klu yi bdag po de yi mthu dpal yin/ /rgyal ba'i nyan thos pa dag ji snyed chos ston dang / /'chad dzodang rigs pa dag dang ldan par brjod pa dang / /mchog 'phags bde ba byed dang bde yi 'bras thob pa/ /de dag kun kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i skyes bu'i mthu/ /ci phyir zhe na rgyal bsalgechos tshul gang bstan pa/ /de la mi mchog slob mar gyur pas mngon bslabs shing cir/ /mngon sum byas nas bslabs 6 pa ji bzhin ston byed de/ /sangs rgyas mthus byed rang gi stobs kyi mthus ma yin/ /gang la shes rab pha rol phyin mchog mi dmigs shing / /byang chub sems dpa' mi dmigs byang chub sems mi dmigs / /de skad thos nas rmongs pa med cing skrag med57)pa/ /byang chub sems dpa' de ni bde gshegs shes rab spyod/ /gzugs med tshor ba med cing 'du shes sems pa0)med/ /de la rnam shes gnas ni rdul tsam yod ma yin/ /de chos kun la mi gnas gnas pa med par spyod/ /yongs su gzung med bde gshegs rnams kyi byang chub 'thob/ /ji ltar kun tu rgyu ba bzo sbyangs shes pa yis / /dmigs med phung po rnam par 'jig pa 'byung ba ltar/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig de ltar chos shes pa/ /mya ngan 'das la mi ca1 reg de ni shes rab gnas/ /yang 'di shes rab 'di ni gang yin su yi yin/ /gang las yin zhes chos 'di thams cad stong par rtog /nye bar brtags71nas zhum pa med cing skrag med pa/ /byang chub sems dpa' de ni byang chub nye ba yinatunye/ /gal te mi shes bzhin du gzugs su 'du shes shing / /tshor ba sems pa rnamarwarteshes phung poramasaspyod byed cing 15/ /phung 'di stong zhes rtog na'ang byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /mtshan ma la spyod skye med gnas la dad ma yin/ /gang zhig 34—4

gzugs min tshor min 'du shes sems pa min/ /rnam par shes la mi spyod gnas pa med par spyod/ /de ni spyod ces bya bar mi dmigs shes rab brten①/ /skye med blo ldan ting 'dzin zhi ba mchog la reg② /byang chub sems gang de ltar 'dir bdag zhirasheganas pa/ /de ni sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pas lung bstan yin / /bdag ni mnyam par bzhag ce'am langs zhes rlom sems med/ /ci phyir zhe na chos kyi rang bzhin yongs shes phyir/ /de ltar spyod na bde gshegs rnams kyi shes rab spyod/ /des ni spyod med spyod pa yin par rab shes phyir/ /chos gang spyod pa de yang dmigs par mi 'gyur te/ /'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod pa yin/ /gang zhig yod pa ma yin de ni med ces bya/ /byis pa rnams kyis de brtags yod dang〈gemed par byed/ /yod dang med pa 'di gnyis med pa'i chos yin te/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang gis 'di shes nges par 'byung / /gang 'dir phung po lnga dag sgyu ma 'drar shes shing / /sgyu ma gzhan dang phung po gzhan du mi byed la/ /sna tshogs 'du shes bral zhing nye bar zhi spyodashepa/ /'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod pa yin/ /dge ba'i bshes dang ldan zhing lhag mthong ldan gyur pa/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi yum thos skragashepar yong mi 'gyur/ /gang zhig sdig pa'i grogs ldan gzhan gyi dring 'jog pa6)/ /de ni snod so ma btang chus reg zhig pa bzhin/ /ci phyir 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' bya zhe na/ /chags pa gcod7byed kun la chags pa zad par 'dod/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi byang chub chags med gyur la reg /des na 'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i ming thobalgebo/ /ci phyir 'dirwarteni sems dpa' che zhes bya zhe na/ /sems can tshogs rnams mang po'i mchog tu gyur pa dang / /sems can khams 31—5

kyi lta rnams chen po gcod pa ste/ /de phyir sems dpa' chen po zhes ni rab brjod do/ /gtong ba che tshobyedang blo che ba dang mthu che〈dang / /rgyal ba rnams kyi theg chen mchog la zhugs pa dang / /go cha chen po bgos gshing bdud kyi sgyu 'dul ba/ /de yi phyir na sems dpa' che zhes rab tu brjod/ /dper na sgyu ma mkhan gyis bzhi mdor sprul byas te/ /skye bo phal chenakhumago mang bye ba gcod byed pa'i/ /gsadasabya de dag ci 'dra de ltar byang chub sems/ /'gro kun sprul 'dra 6)rab shes de la 'jigasalgepa med/ /gzugs dang 'du shes tshor ba dang ni sems pasnyedang / /rnam par shes pa ma bcings spum grol yod pa min/ /de ltar byang chub la 'jug zhum pa'i sems med pa/ /'di ni gang zag dam pa rnams kyi go cha mchog /ci phyir 'di ni byang chub theg chen bya zhe na/ /de gang zhon nas sems can thams cad mya ngan zlo/ /theg pa 'di ni mkha' 'dra gzhal7med khang chen te/ /dga' skyid bde ba mngon par 'thob 37byed theg pa'i mchog /gang zhig zhon nas phyogs su 'gro ba dmigs su med/ /mya ngan 'das par 'gro bar gsungs sna pa 'gro mi dmigs/ /dper na mi shi derwanyeyis 'gro rgyu med pa bzhin/ /rgyu des de tshani mya ngan 'das zhes rab tu brjod/ /byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mtha' dang phyi mtha' dang / / da ltar byung bar nyugemi dmigs dus gsum dag pa ste/ /gang dag de ni 'dus ma byas yin spros med de//'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod pa yin/ /byang chub sems dpa' (stomakhas rigs1 tshogang gi dus kyi tshe/ /skye med rnam par bsams te nyanye'adi ltar spyod byed cing / /snying rje chen po bskyed kyang sems can 'du shes med(rte/ /'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod pa yin/ /gal te sems can 'du shes sdug 34wa 6

bsngal 'du shes skyeda'/ /'gro ba rnams kyi don bya sdug bsngal spang snyam ste/ /bdag dang sems can yongs rtog du byang chub sems dpa' ste/ /'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod ma7yin/ /bdag ci 'dra ba de 'drar sems can thams cad shes/ /sems can thams cad ci 'drar 4)de 'drar chos kun shes/ /skye ba med dang skye ba gnyi gegar mi rtog pa/ /'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod pa yin/ /'jig rten dag na chos ming ji snyed yongs brjod pa/ /kun la skye ba dang ni yang dag 'das spangs nas// /ye shes 'chi med dam pa de las gzhan med 'thobañdza/ /de phyir 'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin ces bya/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig dogs med de ltar spyod/ /shes rab ldan te mnyam nyid gnas par shes par bya/ /chos rnams rang bzhin med par yongs su shes gyur pa/ /'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod pa 8)yin/ / skabs gnyis pa lam thams cad shes pa nyid bstan/du'o) gang zhig gzugs la mi gnas tshor la mi gnas shing ske/ /gang zhig 'du shes mi gnas sems par sna mi gnas la/ /rnam shes gang mi gnas pa chos nyid gnas pa ste/ /'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod pa yin/ /rtag dang mi rtag bde dang sdug bsngal sdug mi sdug /bdag dang bdag med de bzhin nyid dang de bzhin stong / /'bras bu thob dang dgra bcom sa la mi gnas shing / /rang rgyal sa dang de bzhin sangs rgyas sar mi gnas / /ji ltar 'dren pa 'dus ma nyu1byas khams mi gnas shing / /de bzhin 'dus 12byas la yang mi gnas gnas med spyod/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' gnas la gnas med gnas/ /gnas med gnas yin 'di 12ni rgyal bas gnas par gsungs/ /gang dag bde gshegs nyan thos 'gyur bar bya snyam dang / /34—7

rang sangs rgyas dang de bzhin chos rgyal 'gyur 'dod pa/ /bzod pa 'di la ma brtenasamathob par mi nus te/ /dper na tshu rol pha rolas 'gro ngogs mi mthong bzhin / /chos 'chad pa dang nyan dang dro bshad bya gang yin dngasnyi/ /'bras bu thob dang rkyen rgyal de bzhin 'jig rten mgon/ /mkhas pa gsal bas thob pa'i mya ngan 'das gang yin/ /de kun sgyu ma lta bur de bzhin gshegs pasasnyibastan/ /gang zag bzhi po 'di dag de la mi skrag yeste/ /rgyal sras bden la mkhas dang phyir mi ldog pa dang / /dgra bcom dri ma bsal zhing57som nyi spangs pa dang / /bzhi pa dge ba'i bshes ④kyis yongs su zin pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' mkhas rig de ltar spyod pa ni/ /dgra bcom sa la mi slobaturten rtogs sa la min/ /thams cad mkhyen nyid ched du sangs rgyas chos huX rjes slob/ /gang zhig slob mi slob la mi slob de slob yin/ /gzugs 'phel yongs su nyams dang7)yongs su gzung phyir min/ /chos rnams sna tshogs yongs su gzung7phyir mi slob par/ /slob cing thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyang yongs 'dzin la/ /nges 'byung gang yin 'di ni yon tan dga' ba'i slobatunye/ /gzugs ni shes rab ma yin gzugs la shes rab med/ /rnam shes 'du shes tshor dang sems pa 'di dag ni/ /shes rab ma yin 'di dag la yang shes rab med/ /'di ni nam mkha'i khams dang mtshungs te tha dad med/ /dmigs pa rnams kyi rang bzhin de ni pha mtha' ⑨med / /sems can rang bzhin gang yin de yang pha mtha'asnyimed/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi rang bzhin de yang pha mtha' med/ /'jig rten mkhyen pa'i shes rab de yang pha mtha' med/ /'du shes tshu 7rol yin zhes 'dren pas yongs su bsgrags / /'du shes rnam 1 tshopar bshig (snyenas spong ba pha rol 'gro/ /gang dag 34wa 8

'du shes bral ba 'di ni rjes thob pa/ /de dag pha rol phyin nas stiston pa'i bka' la gnas/ /gal te ston pas kyang ni gang gā'ikhubye snyed kyi/ / bskal par bzhugs7te sems can zhes sgra yongs bsgrags kyang / /gzodasnyenas dag pas sems can skye bar ga la 'gyur/ /'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod pa yin/ /gang tshe nga ni pha rol phyin pasnyimachog 'di dang / /'thunarnyupar smra gyur de tshe sngon gyi skyes mchog gis/ /ma 'ongs pa yi dus na sangs rgyas 'gyur ro zhes / /nga lung bstan par gyur ces rgyal ba dekyiskad gsung / /shes rab phaphurol phyin pa gang la mgon spyod pa/ /'di ni gang zhig gus byas 'dzin dang chub byed pa/ /de la dug dang mtshon dang me dang chus mi tshugs/ /bdud dang bdud kyi phyogs kyis glags kyang rnyed7mi 'gyur/ /la las bde gshegs yongs su mya ngan 'das pa yikho/ /mchod rten rin chen bdun las byas shing mchod byed la/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i mchod rten de dag gang gā yonye/ /bye ma snyed kyis bye ba phrag stong zhing bkang ste/ /yongs su brtag bzung zhing rnams bye ba mtha' yas na/ /sems can ji snyed 'khod pa de dag thams cad kyis/ /las gzhan mi byed lha yi tu)me tog spos rab dang / /byug pas dus gsum bskal pa'am de bas lhag mchod la/ /gang zhig gang las rnam 'dren stobs bcu 'byung 'gyur ba/ /bde bar gshegs kyi〈nyeyum 'di glegs bam la bris te/ /'chang zhing me tog byug pas bsti stang byed gyur tshen/ /mchod rten byas mchod bsod nams des ni char mi phod/ /rgyal ba'i shes rab pha rol phyin 'di rig78sngags che / /sems can khams mang mya ngan sdug bsngal chos zhi byed/ /gang dag 'das dang gang dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten mgon/ / rig sngags 'di 34—9

bslabs 1sman pa'i rgyal po bla med gyur / /gang dag phan dang snying rjer bcas pa spyad spyod pa/ /rig casngags 'di la bslabs 95)nas mkhas pa byang chub regane /'dus byas bde dang 'dus ma byas bde gang yin pa/ /bde ba de kun 'di las 'byung 7bar rig par bya/ /sa bon btab nas sa la gnas te 'byung 'gyur ba / /tshogs pa rnyed nas rnam 9mang gzugs dag rnam par skye/ /pha rol phyin lnga byang chub yon tan ji snyed pa/ /de dag kun kyang shes rab pha rol phyin las skye/ /'khor los sgyur 1 rgyal lam gang nas ni rtag 11'gro ba/ /lam de nyid nas 2rin chen bdun dang dpung tshogs kun/ /nyusnyegang nas rgyal ba'i shes rab pha rol phyin 'di 'gro/ /de nyid nas ni yon tan tshechos kun 'gro bar 'gyur / /rgyal bas 15brgya byin dri ba yongs dris lan gsol pa/ /gal te gang gā'i 7bye snyed sangs rgyas zhing gyur la/ /de kun rgyal ba'i ring bsrel byur bur bltams 7gyur kyang / /bdag ni shes rab pha rol 12phyin pa 'di nyid len/ /ci slad ce 19na sku gdung mi gus bdag ma lags/ /'on kyang shes rab yongs su bsgoms 2 pas mchod par bgyid 1/ /dper na rgyal po rten na mi rim gro thobs nyepa ltar/ /sangs rgyas ring bsrel shes rab pha rol phyin la rten dhe/ /nor bu rin chen yon tan 25kun ldan rin thang med ca/ /gab tshe gang du stsal tri ba de ni phyag bgyi 'os/ /de phyung gyur kyang gab tshe la ni dga' bgyid de she/ /yon tan5 rkyede dag nor bu rin chen de yis lags/ /de bzhin shes rab pha rol phyin mchog yon tan gyis/ /rgyal ba mya ngan 'das kyang ring bsrel mchod pa brnyes(1/ /de ltas gang zhig rgyal ba'i yon tan 'dzin 'tshal des/ /shes rab pha rol phyin blang 'di 2ni thar pa lags/ /sbyin pa sbyin pa'i sngon nadu 'gro ba shes rab ste/ /34—10

tshul khrims bzod pa brtson 'grus bsam gtan de bzhin no/ /dge chos chud mi gzan 37phyir yongs su 'dzin pa yin/ /'di ni chos rnams thams cad tshul gcigasho ston par byed/ /dper na 'dzam bu'i gling na shing rirnams bye ba stong / /rnam pa risna tshogs rnam pa du ma gzugs mang ba/ /grib mar gyur pa'i grangs su brjod pa ma gtogs (lde)par/ /grib ma sna tshogs med cing bye brag yod ma yin/ /de bzhin rgyal ba'i pha rol phyin lnga 'di dag kyang / /shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i ming nyid thob par 'gyur/ /thams cad mkhyen pa 6)nyid phyir yongs su bsngos byas na ri/ /byang chub ces 3byar drug po 'di kun ro gcig 'gyur/ /byang chub sems dpa' gal te rab tu mi shes bzhin/ /gzugs dang 'du shes tshor dang sems pa rnam par shes/ /mi rtag 'o yongs su ston pa bcos 1 snal spyod pa ste/ /mkhas pa nam 17yang chos rnams 'jig par mi byed do/ /gang la gzugs min tshor min 'du shes mi dmigs shing / /rnam par shes pa ma yin sems pa mi dmigs la/ /chos kun skye med stong pa'i tshul du rab shes pa/ /'di ni shes rab72pha rol phyin mchog spyod pa yin/ /la las gang gā'i naklung gi bye snyed zhing rnams na/ /sems can ji snyed 'khod kun dgra bcom nyid btul bas/ /gang gis shes rab pha rol phyin 'di yig bris te/ /sems can mchog la glegs byin bsod nams khyad par 'phags/ /ci phyir zhe na smra mchog de dag 'dir bslabs 1 nas / /chos rnams mtha' dag stong pa nyid du 'dir ston byed/ /de thos 7nyan thos myur du rnam par grol la reg /rang rgyal byang chub dang ni sangs rgyas byang chub reg /myu gu med par 'jig rten sdong 'byung 8yong med na/ /de la yal 'dab nyu 7me tog 'bras ri1 bu ga la 'byung / /byang chub sems med rgyal 'byung 34—11

'jig rten yong med na/ /'bras bu brgya byin tshangs pa nyan thos ga la 'byung / /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gang tshe 'od kyi dra ba 'gyedakyi/ /de tshe sems can las byed brtson pa de bzhin du/ /mkhas par shes phyir 'jig rten byang chub sems byung na / /ye shes kyis ni sems can yon tan chos dang ldan/ /dper na ma dros mtsho la ri klu bdag med gyur na/ /'dzam bu'i gling 'dir chu klung 'bab par dug la 'gyur/ /chu klung med ldan me tog 'bras bu 'byung mi 'gyur/ /rgya mtsho la yang rin chen gzugs mang med par 'gyur/ /de bzhin 'dir yang byang chub sems med bde 6gshegs kyi/ /ye shes 'jig rten 'di dag kun du ⑦ga la 'byung ske/ /ye shes med na yon tan 'phel med byang chub med/ /rgya mtsho 'dra ba'i sangs rgyas chos kyang med par 'gyur/ /'jig rten 'di na snang byed srog chags ji snyed pa/ /kun gyis snang bar bya phyir 'od rnams phyung7ba bas/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od zer gcig phyung ches stimachog ste/ /snang byed tshogs kyi 'od rnams kun gyis char mi yod/ /nyan thos tshogs rnams ji snyed sbyin dang tshul khrims dang / /bsgom dang rab tu ldan pa'i bsod nams tshogs bskyed pa'ang 1 / /byang chub sems dpa'i 31rjes su yi〈nyerang sems gcig la/ /nyan thos tshogs kyi tsho bsod nams phung pos char mi phod/ /'das dus sngon gyi sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig gang / /zhing mang mtha' yas bye skostong dag na gang bzhugs dang ske/ /gang yang mya ngan 'das pa 8'jig rten mgon po rnams/ /sdug bsngal zad par bya phyir rin chen chos ston pa/ /dang po byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed 7bskyed pa nas/ /rnam par 'dren pa rnams kyi dam chos zad kyi dus/ /de 1 bar rgyal ba de dag bsod nams gang yin pa/ /pha rol phyin dang ldan dang〈she34—12

sangs rgyas chos gang dang / /gang yangashesangs rgyas sras rnams dang ni nyan thos dang / /slob dang mi slob dge ba zag bcas zag med pa/ /bsdus nasarkubyang chub sems dpa' rjes su yisarang zhing / /'gro ba'i don rgyu byang chub phyir ni thams cad bsngo / /yongs bsngo0gal te sems su 'du shes 'byung 'gyur zhing ske/ /byang chub 'du shes yongs bsngotswasems can 'du shes na/ /'du shes phyir na ⑦lta gnas sems ni gsum la chags/ /dmigs pa yod pas yongs su bsngo bar7chud ma yin/ /gal te 'di ltar chos 'di 'gags shing7zad pa dang ske/ /gang du yongs su bsngo ba de yang zad pa dang / /chos kyis chos la nam yang mi bsngorkakye shes gyur na/ /de ltar rab tu shes pas yongs su bsngos pa yin/ /gal te mtshanamanyamar byed na de ni bsngo ma yin/ /ji〈nyeste mtshan ma med na byang chub bsngo nyeb yin/ /ji ltar dug dang 'dres pa'i kha zas bzang za btso/ /dkar po'i chos la dmigs pa'ang de 'drar rgyal bas gsungs/ /de ltas 'di ltar yongs su bsngo ba bslab bya ste/ /ji ltar rgyal ba de dag dge ba de mkhyen pa'i8ske/ /rnam pa gang yin 'byung gang mtshan nyid gang7yin la/ /rjes su yi hu rang de lta hunyede ltar yongs su bsngo/ /de ltar bsod nams byang chub yongs su bsngo byed na/ /dug med sangs rgyas mi spong rgyal bas gsungs hunyepa smra/ /de ltar yongs bsdomanye dpa' bo 'jig rten dmigs can gyi(1/ /byang chub sems dpa' ji snyed thams cad zil gyis gnon()/ /dmus long dmigs bumanyemed pa bye ba khrag khrig rnams/ /lam yang mi shes grong khyer 'jug par ga la 'gyur/ /shes rab med na mig med pha rol phyin lnga 'di( ste/ /dmigs bu med pasamanyebyang chub reg par nus ma yin/ /gang tshe shes rab kyis ni rab tu zin gyur na(9/ /31—13

de tshe mig rnyed gyur cing 'di yis1)ming thob bo/ /dper na ri mo'i las ni yongs zin mig med pa/ /ji srid mig ma bris pasatshananorngan pa mi thob bzhin/ /gang tshe 'dus byas 'dus ma byas dang dkar nag chos/ /shes rab rnam par bshig0)nas rdul tsam 4mi dmigs tshe/ /'jig rten dag na shes rab pha rol phyin grangs 'gro/ /nam mkha' gang la'ang cung zad mi gnas de dang 'dra/ /gal te bdag ni rgyal ba'i shes rab spyad 5bya zhing / /sems can sdug bsngal reg pa khrag khrig mang dgrol sems/ /sems can 'du shes yongs rtog chu)byang chub sems dpa' ste/ /'di 7ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod ma yin/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig sngon chad spyod pa'i tshe/ /pha rol phyin 'dir spyod pa mkhas pa som nyi named/ /thos ma thag tu des 9ni ston pa'i 'du shes skyedapa/ /des ni 1 byang chub zhi ba myur du rtogs par 'gyur/ /sngon spyad 1 tshe na sangs rgyas khrag khrig bkur byas kyang / /rgyal ba'i shes rab pha rol phyin la ma dad na/ /thos nas blo chung de lha yis 'di ni spong byed de/ /spangs nas skyabs med gyur pa de ni mnar med 'gro/ /de lta bas na gal te sangs rgyas ye shes mchog /reg par 'dod na rgyal ba'i yum 'dir dad par gyis 6/ /dper na tshong pa rin chen gling du song nas ni/ /zong zad slar log lta bur gyur na mi rung ngo / /gzugs kyi dag pa 'bras bu dag par rig par bya/ /'bras bu gzugs dag thams cad mkhyen nyid dag par 'gyur1ge/ /thams cad mkhyen nyid 'bras bu dag dang gzugs dag pa/ /nam mkha'i khams dang mtshungs te dbyer med gcad du med/ / skabs gsum pa gzhi thams cad shes pa bstan/glu dpa' bo gar spyod shes rab pha rol phyin pa yis/ /khams gsum yang dag 'das la rnam par grol 34wa 14

ba'ang min①/ /nyon mongs bsalakhubar gyur kyang skye ba ston par byed/ /rgasadang na dang 'chi ba med kyang 'chi 'pho ston/ /'gro ba 'di dag ming dang gzugs kyi 'dam la chags/ /rlung gi 'khor lo lta bu'i 'khor ba'i 'khor lor 'khyam ske/ /'gro ba 'khrul pa ri dgas55)rgyar chudapo 'drar shes nas/ /shes rab ldan pa mkha'atso)la bya bzhinangaspurnam par rgyu/ /spyod pa yongs dag gang zhig gzugs la mi spyod cing / /rnam shes 'du shes tshor ba sems par mi spyod na/ /de ltar spyod pa chags pa thams cad yongs spong zhing / /chags las rnam grol bde gshegs rnams kyi shes rab spyod/ /de ltar spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' mkhas gsal ba/ /chags pa bcad nas 'gro la chags pa med par 'gro/ /nyi ma sgra gcan gza' bral lhang 9nger 'dug pa dang / /me btang rtswa dang shing dang skyanags tshal sreg pa bzhin/ /chos rnams thams cad rang bzhin dag cing yongs dag par/ /byang chub sems dpa' shes rab pha rol phyin lta na/ /byed pa po yang mi dmigs 31chos kun mi dmigs te/ /'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog lju1da pa yin/ / skabs bzhi pa rnam pa kun mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa bstan/32 rgyal ba la ni lha rgyal brgya byin gyis zhus pa/ /byang chub sems dpa' shes rab spyod pa ji ltar brtson / /phung po khams la rdul spyi tsam brtson par mi byed cing / /phung por mi brtson de ni byang chub sems dpa' chubartson/ /gang zhig chos 'di sprul dang sgyutsha8ma 'drar thos 8nas/ /som nyi 1 med cing slob la phyir zhing sbyor〈gebyed pa/ /sems can de ni ring nas theg chen zhugs rig bya/ /sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig mang la lhag byas yin/ /dgon pa'i lam ni dpag tshad mang por zhugs pa'i mis / /gnag rdzi mtshams kyi nags tshal phun sum nyurtetshogs mthong nas/ /'di ri ri34—15

dag grong dang grong khyer nye ba'i rtags 7snyam ste/ /dbugs phyin rnyed par 'gyur zhing (2chom rkun ge'ajigs pa med/ /de bzhin byang chub yongs su tshol ④tshe rgyal rnams kyi/ /shes rab pha rol phyin 'di mnyan pa gang thob pa/ /de ni dbugs phyin thob par gyur cing 'jigs med de/ /dgra bcom sa la ma yin rkyen rtogs sa la min/ /mi zhig rgya mcho1re chu ni blta phyir 'gro ba yis/ /gal te shing dang nags tshal ri mthong da dung ring / /ci7ste rtags ma mthong na rgya mtsho chen po ni/ /nye bar zhu)gyur to snyam steshede la som nyisamed/ /de ltar byang chub dam par rab zhugs rgyal ba yitho)/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa 'di mnyan rig par bya/ /rnam par 'dren pas mngon sum lung bstan ma gyur kyang / /sangs rgyas byang chub ring por mi thogs bdag reg 'gyur/ /dpyid dus bzang la sdong po lo ma lhags gyur na/ /yal gas ring por71mi thogs lo 'bras me tog skrun / /shes rab pha rol phyin 'di su yi 3gelag thob pa/ /ring por mi thogs 'dren pa rnams kyi byang chub thobatunye/ /dper na bud med sbrum gang sdug bsngal nyen gyur na/ /de ni de yi btsa' ba'i dus la bab ces7bya/ /de bzhin byang chub sems dpa' rgyal ba'i shes rab nyan/ /dga' dang 'dun pa skyed pa myur du byang chub reg /shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod tshe rnal 'byor pa/ /gzugs kyi 'phel ba dang ni yongs su 'grib nyanyemi mthong / /gang zhig chos dang chos min chos dbyings mi mthong zhing / /mya ngan 'das la mi reg de ni shes rab gnas / /gang zhig 'dir spyod sangs rgyas chos rnams mi rtog stetsho/ /stobs dang rdzu 'phrul rkang pa byang chub zhi mi rtog /rnam par mi rtog rtog bral byin gyi rlabs kyis spyod/ /'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod pa yin/ /smra ba'i 34—16

zla ba sangs rgyas la ni rab 'byor zhus/ /yon tan dga' ba rnams kyi bar du gcod gang lags/ /ston pas bka' stsal bar du gcod par 'gyur mang ste/ /de las re zhig0)cung zad tsam zhig yongs su brjod/ /rgyal ba'i shes rab pha rol phyin 'di yig 'drikyitshe/ /spobs pa tha dad rnamakhupa du ma 'byung 'gyur zhing ske/ /'gro ba'i don ma byas par glog bzhin myur du yang / /yongs su nyams par 'gyur ba 'di ni bdud kyi las/ /'di bshad tshe na kha cig som nyi za 'gyur te/ /'dren pas 'dir ni bdag gi ming yang yongs ma brjod/ /rigs dang sa dang rus kyang yongs su ma brjod ces/ / 'di ni ⑤nyan par mi 'gyur spong7'gyur bdud kyi las/ /de ltar mi shes de dag rtsa ba borashenas ni/ /rmongs pasasheyal ga dag dang 'dabashem tshol bar 'gyur/ /glang po rnyed nasamatsoglang po'i rjes ni tshol ba ltar/ /shes rab pha rol phyin thos mdo tshol de bzhin no/ /dper na la las (mero brgya ldan pa'i zas rnyed 'kho/ /zas mchog rnyed nas zas ngan tshol bar byed pa ltar/ /byang chub sems dpa' pha rol phyin pa 'di rnyed nas / /dgra bcom sa yis byang chub tshol byed de bzhin no/ /bstikhesang 'dod par 'gyur zhing rnyed7pa 'dod 'gyur mdang / /lha dang bcas pa'i sems kyis khyim 'dris byed ldan zhing / /chos btang nas ni chos min bya ba spyod 'gyur ba / /lam bor lam gol 'gro ba 'di ni bdud kyi las/ /gang dag de yi tshe na 'dun cing dad gyur nas/ /chos kyi dam pa 'di ni nyan du song ba las/ /de dag gis ni chos smra bya ba ldan rig nas/ /dga' ba med cing yid mi bde bar gyur nas 'gro/ /de yi tshe na bdud kyi las 'di 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de tshe gang dag gis ni dge slong mang dkrugs nas/ /shes rab pha rol phyin 'di 'dzin 34—17

par mi 'gyur ba'i/ /bar du gcod pa rnam mang gzhan yang 'byung bar 'gyur/ /rin chen rin thang med pa rnyed 'gyur 3)gang dag yin/ /de dag dkon la dus rnams rtag tu 'tshe ba'ang mang / /de bzhin rgyal ba'i shes rab pha rol phyin pa mchog /rin chen chos kyang dkon la rtag tu 'tshe 2ba'ang mang / /theg pashegasar du zhugs pa'i sems can blo chung ba/ /gang zhig dkon pa'i rin chen 'di ni ma rnyed pang / /de la bar chad bya phyir bdud ni spro bar 'gyur/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas de dag yongs su 'dzin la sbyor/ /ma zhig na bar gyur la bu ni mang yod pa/ /de kun yid mi bde zhing de la rim grosasnibyed/ /de bzhin phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams kyi sangs rgyas kyang / /yum gyur shes rab dam pa 'di la dgongs pa mdzad/ /gang dag 'das dang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten mgon gang dang / /ma 'ongs dus na 'byung 'gyur de dag 'di las 'byung / /'jig rten ston pa rgyal ba rnams kyi skyed byed yum/ /sems can gzhan gyi 6 sems kyi spyod pa ston 7par byed/ /'jig rten de bzhin nyid dang dgra bcom de bzhin nyid / /rang rgyal de bzhin nyid dang rgyal sras de bzhin nyid/ /gcig pa nyid de dngos bral gzhan min de bzhin nyid/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa de bzhin gshegs pas mkhyen/ /mkhas pa 'jig rten gnas sam mya ngan 'das kyang rung / /chos nyid skyon med chos rnams stong pa 'di gnas te/ /byang chub sems dpa' nide bzhin nyid 'di rjes su rtogs/ /de phyir de bzhin gshegs zhes ri/risangs rgyas mtshan gsol to/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa / dga' tshal la rten 31pa/ /stobs bcu rnam 'dren rnams nyi kyi spyod yul 'di yin te/ /sems can sdug bsngal ngan song gsum las yongs 'don kyang / /de dag nam yang 32sems can 'du shes 34—18

'gyur ba med/ /dper na seng ge tsho1)ri sul brten snonas 'jigs med par/ / ri dgas maphra mo mang skrag byed cing sgra sgrogs laltar/ /mi yi seng ge shes rab pha rol phyin brten nas/ /mu stegs can mang skrag byed 'jig rten sgra yang sgrogs⑤/ /dper na nam mkhar thoganas pa'i nyi ma'i 'od zer ni/ /sa 'di skems7par byed cing gzugs kyang rab tu ston/ /de bzhin chos rgyal shes rab pha rol phyin rten0)pa/ /srid pa'i chu klung skems shing tso)chos kyang rab tu ston/ /gzugs rnams mi mthong tshor ba dgas/ )kyang mi mthong zhing / /'dumanyashes mthong ba med la sems pa mi mthong zhing / /gang la rnam par shes dang sems yid mthong med pa / /'di ni chos mthong yin zhes de bzhin gshegs pas bstan/ /nam mkha' (rtemathong zhes sems can tshig tu rab brjod pa/ /nam mkha'aphanyeji ltar mthong stehūdon 'di brtag par gyisam/ /de ltar chos mthong ba yang de bzhin gshegs pas bstan / /mthong ba dpe gzhan gyis ni bsnyad par nus ma yin/ /gang gis5)de ltar mthong ba de yis chos kun mthong / /rgyal po btang snyoms 'dug cing blon po kun byed ltar/ /sangs rgyas mdzad dang nyan thos chos rnams ji snyed pa/ /de dag thams cad shes rab pha rol phyin pa byed/ /rgyal po grong du mi 'gro yul 'khor mi 'gro lo3/ /rang gi yul nasarwa/'du ba thams cad sdud pa ltar/ /byang chub sems dpa'i chos nyid gang du'ang mi 'gro la/ /sangs rgyas sa yi shu )yon tan gang yin thams cad sdud/ /gang la bde gshegs byang chub sems dpa' dad brtan yod/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa mchog la bsam sbyor ba/ /nyan thos rang rgyal sa gnyis shin tu 'das byas nas/ /zil gyis mi non nu1rgyal ba'i byang chub myur du thobadu rnye/ /dper na rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru ni chag gyur la/ /34—19

mi gang ro 'am rtswa 'am shing ni mi 'dzin pa3)/ /chu dbus 'jigakhupar 'gyur te ngogs su phyin mi 'gyur/ /gang zhig 'dzin pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol phyin par 'gyur//de ltar dad ldan dang ba thob pa gang zhig ni/ /shes rab pha rol phyin yum rjes su mi 'jug min/ /ri de dag thabs kyi yon tan shes rab yongs zin na/ /mchog tu rmad byung bde gshegs byang chub myur du reg /dper na la las rdza so ma btang chu skyed 45)na/ /nyam chung phyir na4)myur du 'jig par rig par bya/ /so btang bum par chu skyed lam du 'jig pa yi/ /'jigayopa med cing bde bar khyim du phyin par 'gyur/ /de bzhin byang chub sems dpa' dudad pa mang7gyur kyang ske/ /shes rab rnam par nyams na / )myur du ma rung〈nye'agyur/ / dad pasarwanyeshes rab kyis /lhani yongs su zin gyur na/ /sa gnyis shin tu 'das te byang chub mchog thob 'gyur/ /dper na bcos legs ma byas gru ni rgya mchoXre nang / /nor dang bcas shing tshong par bcas te 'jig par 'gyur/ /gru de legs par bcos legs byas dang ldan gyur na/ /mi 'jig nor dang bcas par ngogs su phyin par 'gyur/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' dad pas yongs bsgos7kyang / /shes rab med na byang chub las ni myur nyams 'gyur/ /de nyid shes rab pha rol phyin pa mchog ldan na/ /ma smas skam nyams rgyal ba'i byang chub reg par 'gyur/ /lo brgya nyi shu lon te rgas shing sdug bsngal mi/ /langs kyang bdag nyid 'gro bar nus pa ma yin te/ /de ni g.yas g.yon gnyis nas mi yis rten byas na8/ /'gyel ba'i 'jigs pa med cing bde blag 'gro bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin byang chub sems dpa' shes rab stobs chung ba1 tsho/ /rab tu zhugs par gyur kyang rab tu nyams par 'gyur/she/ /de nyid thabs dang shes rab mchog gis yongs zin na/ /34—20

mi nyams de bzhin gshegs kyi byang chub reg par 'gyur/ /byang chub sems dpa' dang po'i las kyi sar gnas gang / /lhag pa'i bsam pas sangs rgyas byang chub mchog zhugs pa/ /slob ma bzang po bla mnyegus ldan de dag gis/ /bla ma mkhas pa rnams la rtag tu bsten⑧par bya/ /ci phyir zhe na mkhas pa'i yon tan de las 'byung / /de dag shes rab pha rol phyin pa rjes su ston/ /sangs rgyas chos rnams dge ba'i bshes la rtenasato zhes/ /yon tan kun gyi mchog mnga' rgyal ba de skad gsungasnyi/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod dngasnyide bzhin brtson 'grus dang / /bsam gtan shes rab byang chub yongs su bsngo bar gyis/ /byang chub phung por zhen nas mchog 'dzin ma byed ces/ /dang po'i las can de la de skad bstan par bya/ /de ltar spyod pa legs mtsho smra ba'i zla ba rnams/ /'gro ba'i skyabs dang dpung gnyenasredang ni gnas yin te/ /rten dang blo dang gling dang yongs 'dren don 'dod pa⑦/ /gsal byed sgron ma chos mchog smra ba mi 'khrugs yin/ /grags chen ldan rnams bya dka'apogo cha gyon byed de/ /phung po khams dang skyelamached rnams kyi go cha min/ /theg gsum 'du shes bral zhing yongs su bzung ba med⑩/ /mi ldog g.yo ba med cing mi 'khrugs chos can yin/ /de dag 'dirwaskre'adra'i chos dang ldan zhing spros pa med/ /the tshom som nyinyeyid gnyis bral zhing don dang ldan/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa thosalgenas mi nur ba//gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog cing mi ldog rig par bya/ /'dren pa rnams kyi chos 'di zab ste mthong bar dka'/ /sus kyang rtogs pa med cing thob par 'gyurachamed pa / /de phyir phan mdzad brtser7ldan byang chub brnyes nas ni⑩/ /sems can tshogs sus shes snyam thugs khral chung bar mdzad/ /sems can rnams ni gnas 31—21

la dga' zhing yul rnams 'dod1/ /'dzin la gnas shing mi mkhas blun rmongs mun pa bzhin/ /thob par bya ba'i chos ni gnas med 'dzin med de/ /des na 'jig rten dag dang rtsod pa 'byung ba yin/ /nam mkha'i khams ni shar gyi phyogs dang lho phyogs dang / /de bzhin nub kyi phyogs dang byang phyogs pha mtha' yas / /steng dang 'og dang phyogs bcu'i ji snyed rnams na'ang yod/ /tha dad gyur pa med cing bye brag gyur pa med/ /'das pa'i de bzhin nyid〈gegang ma byon du dzide bzhin nyid/ /da ltar de bzhin nyid gang dgra bcom de bzhin nyid/ /chos kun de bzhin nyid gang rgyal ba'i 4 de bzhin nyid/ /chos kyi de bzhin nyid 'di thams cad bye brag med/ /bde gshegs byang chub tha dad chos dang bral gyur pa//'di ni byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig thob 'dod pa/ /thabs dang ldan pas shes rab pha rol phyin la sbyor/ /'dren pa'i shes rab med na thob par 'gyur ma yin / /bya zhig lus che dpag tshad brgya rtsa lnga bcu par/ /gyur la 'dab gshog zad de nyam 5rtsal yod min na/ /de yis sum cu rtsa gsum gnas nas 'dzam gling 'dir/ /bdag nyid mchongs na der ni nyam nyes gyur pa meyin/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi pha rol phyin pa lnga 'di yang / /bskal 7pa bye ba khrag khrig mang por bsgrub dbyas shing / /smon lam mtha' yas rgya chen 'jig rten rtag bsten rtekyang / /thabs med shes rab bral ba nyan thos nyid du ltung / /sangs rgyas theg pa 'di la nges par 'byung 'dod gang / /'gro ba kun la 1 )sems snyoms pha ma'i 'du shes dang ske/ /phan 1pa'i sems dang byams pa'i yid kyis brtul 12bya zhing / /tha ba med cing drang la tshig 'jam smra bar bya/ /'jig rten mgon la gnas brtan rab 'byor yongs zhus pa/ /yon tan rgya mtsho 1 nyon mongs ma mchis rtags 34—22

bstan0)gsol/ /mthu che ba dag52)ji ltar slar ldog mi 'gyur ba/ /de ltar yon tan phyogs tsam rgyal bas lung bstan gsol/ /tha dad 'du shes bral zhing rigs pa ldan tshig smra/ /dge sbyong dag dang bram ze gzhan la rten mi byed/ /mkhas pa rgyadus rnams rtag tu lingan song gsum po spangs/ /de dag dge bcu'i las kyi lam la mngon par brtson/ /zang zing med par 'gro la chos ni rjes su ston / /chos la gcig tu dga' zhing rtag tu tshig 'jam ldan/ /'gro 'chag nyal dang 'dug par shes bzhin rab tu ldan/ /gnya'askor shing gang tsam lta zhing 'gro la ⑥sems 'khrul med/ /gtsang byas gtsang ma'i gos 'chang gsum po dben zhingashedag /rnyed 'dod ma yin khyu mchog rtag tu chos 'dod pa/ /bdud kyi yul las 'das shing gzhan gyi (nyedring mi 'jog /bsam gtan bzhi la bsam gtanashebasam gtan der mi gnas/ /grags pa 'dod pa ma yin khro bas sems dkris med/ /khyim par gyur kyang nyu )rtag tu dngos po kun ma chags/ /'tsho ba'i phyir ni ya ngas longs spyod tshol mi byed/ /drag shul spyod sngags mi byed bud med sbyor sngags min/ /'dod pa'i las can pho mor 'gyur zhes ston mi byed/ /rab tu dben pa'i shes rab pha rol phyin mchog brtson/ /'thab dang rtsod 31dang bral zhing byams pa'i sems kyang brtan32/ /kun mkhyen 'dod cing brtan nyusnyel rtag tu gzhol sems ldan/ /mtha' 'khob kla klo'i skye bo'i boyul mtha' rnam par spangs/ /rang gi sa la dogs med rtag tu ri rab 'dra/ /chos phyir srog kyang 'dor zhing rnal 'byor rab tu brtson/ /mi ldog rtags 7ni 'di dag yin par shes par bya/ /gzugs dang tshor dang 'du shes sems pa tsornam shes rnams/ /zab ste rang bzhin mtshan ma med cing rab zhi ba/ /dper na 31—23

mda' yis rgya mchoXre gting thug tshol ba ltar/ /shes rab kyis ni brtags na phung po'i gting mi rnyed/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig de ltar zab gyur cing ske/ /theg pa don dam chags med gang la phung po dang / /khams dang skye mched yod min chos 'di rtogs pa de'i/ /bsod nams yang dag grubatupa de las ci zhig yod/ /dper na 'dod chags chos la spyod pa'i skyes bu zhig /bud med dus btab de dang ma phrad de yi ni/ /nyin gcigashesems kyi rnam rtog spyod pa ji snyed pa/ /de snyed bskal par ③byang chub sems dpas thob par 'gyur / /byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig bskal mang bye stong du/ /dgra bcom rang rgyal sbyin byed tshul khrims srunga'aji byed kyang / /gang zhig shes rab pha rol phyin mchog ldan pa'i chos/ /brjod pa'i legs pa sbyinasnyidang tshul khrims char mi phodam/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig shes rab mchog bsgoms te/ /de las langs nas gos pa med pa'i chos brjod cing / /de yang 'gro ba'i don phyirarnyubyang chub rgyur bsngo 7)na/ /dge ba de dang mnyam pa 'jig rten gsum na med/ /bsod nams de yang nagasog dang de bzhin stong pa dang / /gsob dang ya ma brla 9dang snying po med par shes3 / /de ltar bde gshegs rnams kyi shes rab spyad spyod na/ /spyod tshe bsod nams dpag tu med pa yongs su 'dzin/ /sangs rgyas kyis bshad rab tu spyod hunyecing rab bstan pa'i/ /chos 'di thams cad brjod pa tsam du zad shes nas/she/ /bskal pa bye bcakhrag khrig mang por brjod byas kyang / /chos kyi dbyings la zad pa med cing 'phel ba med/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi pha rol phyin ces bya ba gang / /chos de rnams kyang ming tsam du ni yongs su bsgrags/ /yongs bsngo sarlom sems med pa'i byang chub sems dpa' 34—24

ni / /nyams pa med cing sangs rgyas byang chub mchog reg 'gyur/ /'bru mar snying po 'bar ba phrad7pa dang po yis/ /snying po tshig min de med par yang de mi tshig /me lce phrad pa tha mas7snying po tshig min la/ /me lce tha ma med par snying po tshig min ltar/ /dang po'i sems kyis byang chub mchog reg ma yin la/ /de med par yang de la reg par nus ma yin/ /tha ma'i sems kyis byang chub zhi ba thob min la/ /de med par yang de thobashe/nus pa ma yin no/ /sa bon las ni myu gu me tog 'bras bu 'byung / /de yang 'gags byal shing yang med pa der min ltar/ /de bzhin dang po'i sems kyang byang chub rgyu yin te/ /de yang 'gags rgyal byang chub med pa de ma yin⑦/ / chu yi spuzigs pas bum pa dang po tha ma'i bar/ / rim gyis khyanyung ngu nyung ngusatshwa) de yongs 'gengs pa ltar/ /de bzhin dang po'i sems kyang byang chub mchog rgyu ste/ / rim gyis hunyadakar po'i yon tan rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas()'gyur/ /stong pa mtshan med smon pa med pa'i /rtechos spyod cing / /mya ngan 'das la mi reg mtshan mar mi spyod pa/ /dper na mnyanasapa mkhas pa phar 'gro tshur 'gro yang / /mtha' gnyis mi gnas rgya mtshor gnas pa med pa bzhin/ /de ltar spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam bdag /stobs bcus lung bstan byang chub reg 'gyur rlom sems med/ /'di la ci yang med ces byang chub skrag7pa med/ /de ltar spyod pa bde gshegs shes rab spyod pa yin/ /'jig rten dgon7pa'i lam dang mu ge nad bcas par / /mthong nas skrag pa med cing de nas go gyon te/ /phyi ma'i mu mthar rtag tu brtson zhing rab shes nas/ /yongs su skyo ba'i yid ni rdul tsam skyed lha tshomi byed//byang chub sems dpa' rgyal ba'i shes rab spyod byed cing / /phung po 'di dag 34—25

gdod nas stong zhing skye med shes/ /mnyam par ma bzhag sems can khams la snying rje 'jug /bar skabs der yang sangs rgyas chos las7yongs mi nyams/ /dper na skyes bu mkhas pa yon tan kun ri ldan zhing / /stobs ldan mi thub brtson byas sgyu rtsal /cho ga shes/ /'phong dang bzo gnas mang po'i pha rol phyin gyur cing / /sgyu ma sgrub shes 'gro don rab tu 'dod pa zhig /pha dang ma dang chung mar bcas par 4)yongs bsdus nas/ /dgra byed mang ba5gedagon pa'i lam du phyin pa dang / /de yis dpa' zhing rtul phod skyes55bu mang sprul te/ /bde bar song zhing phyir yang khyim du 'ong ba ltar/ /de bzhin de tshe byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pa yang / /sems can khams rnams kun du snying rje cher bskyed cing ske/ /bdud bzhi dag dang sa gnyis las kyang rab 'das nas/ /ting 'dzin mchog la gnas shing byang chub reg mi byed/ /mkha' la rlung brten⑧de la chu yi 9phung po brten1 tsho/ /de la sa chen 'di brten nyanyade la 'gro ba brtenanyurte/ /sems can las la spyod pa'i rgyu ni de 'dra ste/ /nam mkha' gang la gnas yin don 'di bsam par gyis/ /de bzhin byang chub sems dpa' stong pa nyid gnas pa / /'gro la sems can shes pa'i smon lam rten tu can gyis8/ /bya ba rnam pa sna tshogs du ma ston byed cing / /mya ngan 'das la mi reg stong par gnas pa med / /gang gi tshe na byang chub sems dpa' mkhas gsal ba/ /stong pa zhi ba'i ting 'dzin dam pa 'di spyod pa/ /bar skabs der ni mtshan ma rab tu sgom 8mi byed / /mtshan ma med par gnas shing zhi la rab zhi spyod/ /bar snang 'phur ba'i bya la gnas yod ma yin te/ /de na gnas pa ma yin sa la ltung ⑩mi 'gyur/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' rnam thar sgor spyod pa/ /mya ngan 'das la mi reg 34—26

mtshan mar spyod ma yin/ /dper na 'phong bslabs7)skyes bus gnam du mda' 'phangs te/ /mda' gzhan dag gis0)phyi bzhin brgyud mar long btags te6)/ /snga ma'i mda' de sa la ltung ba'i skabs mi byed④/ /mi de 'dod na mda' de sa la lhung bar 'gyur/ /de ltar shes rab pha rol phyin pa mchog spyod pa/ /shes rab thabs stobs rdzu 'phrul gyis ni rnam spyod pa/ /de dag dge ba'i rtsa ba ji srid ma rdzogs pa/ /de srid stong nyid dam pa de ni thob mi byed/ /dper na dge slong rdzu 'phrul stobs mchog ldan pa zhig /nam mkhar gnas te cig char cho 'phrul rnamadza par 'phrul/ /'gro dang 'chag pa dang ni nyal dang 'dug pa ston/ /de ni skyo ba med cing de la dub pa med/ /de bzhin byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pa stong gnas shing / /ye shes rdzu 'phrul pha rol son la gnas pa med/ /'gro ba dag la bya ba rnam pa mtha' yas ston/ /bskal pa bye bar skyo ba med cing dub pa med/ /dper na mi 'ga' g.yang sa chen por 'dug byed cing / /lag pa gnyi gas gdugs gnyis 'dzin cing nam mkha' la/ /mchongartso6ribar byed cing g.yang sa chen por lus bor nas(7kyi/ /ltung bar mi 'gyur ji srid der ni 'gro bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pa snying rjer gnas/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis kyi gdugs ni yongs bzung ste/ /chos rnams stong pa mtshan med smon pa med rtog cing / /mya ngan 'das la reg pa med la chos kyang mthong ske/ /dper na rin chen 'dod pa rin chen gling song ste/ /rin chen rnyed nas phyir yang khyim du 'ongs gyur pa6)/ /der ni ded dpon 'ba' zhig bde bar 'tsho byed cing / /gnyen bshes tshogs yid mi bder 'jog pa min pa ltar//de bzhin byang chub sems dpa' stong nyid rin chen gyi/ /gling du song ste bsam 31—27

gtan dbang po stobs thob pa/ /mya ngan 'das la reg pa 'ba' zhigatumangon dga' zhing / /sems can sdug bsngal yid du 'jog par 'gyur ma yin/ /dper na don gnyer tshong pa rgyus shes bya ba'i phyir/ /bar gyi grong khyer grong rdal7grong gang yin param 'gro/ /der yang mi gnas rin chen gling du'ang mi gnas la / /rig pa khyim du mi gnas lam la mkhas par 'gyur/ /de bzhin byang chub sems dpa' gsal te la nyan thos dang / /rang rgyal rnams kyi shes pa rnam grolasnyikun la mkhas/ /de la mi gnas 46)sangs rgyas ye shes gnas ma yin/ /'dus ma byas la mi gnas lam gyi tshul shes yin/ /gang tshe 'gro la byams pas rjes su 'brel byas nas/ /ting 'dzin stong pa mtshan med smon pa med spyod pa/ /de ni mya ngan 'das pa thob par 'gyur zhe 'am/ /'dus byas yin par gdags nus de ni gnas med do/ /dper na sprul pa'i mi lus mi snang ma yin zhing / /de ni ming gis kyang ni gdags par nus pa ltar/ /de bzhin byang chub sems dpa' rnam thar sgor spyod pa/ /de ni ming gis /kyang ni gdagasalgepar nus pa yin/ /gal te spyod pa dang 9 ni dbang po yongs dris 1 skul/ /byang chub sems dpa' stong pa 11mtshan ma med pa'i chos/ /yongs su mi ston phyir mi ldog pa'i sa yi mchos/ /mi 'chad de ni lung ma bstan par sna rig par khubya/ / skabs lnga pa rtse mo mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa bstan/sa dgra bcom sa dang rkyen gyi masangs rgyas ye shes dang / /khams gsum dag la rmi lam na yang mi 'dod cing / /sangs rgyas rnams mthong 'gro la chos kyang ston byed pa/ /de ni mi ldog lung bstan yin par rig par bya/ /rmi lam na ni sems can ngan song gsum gnas mthong / /skad〈nyecig de la ngan song rgyun gcad 1 smon lam 'debs/ /bden pa'i byin gyis brlabs du ) kyis me 34—28

yi phung po zhi/ /de ni mi ldog lung bstan yin par rig par bya/ /mi yi pho 'jig rten 'byung po'i gdon dang nad mang ba/ /phan dang snying brtserashon ldan pa'i bden pa'i byin gyis zhi/ /'on kyang rlom5gesems med cing nga rgyal skye med pa/ /de ni mi ldog lung bstan yin par rig par bya/ /ci ste de ni bden pa'i byin rlabasaphusna tshogs dag(5) /'byor pas bdag lung bstan snyam rlom sems 'byung ba 'am/ /gal te byang chub sems dpa' gzhan gyis7lung bstan rlom/ /rlom sems gnas pa de ni blo chung shes par bya/ /ming gi gzhi las bdud ni nye bar 'ongs gyur nas/ /'di skad smras te〈pe'adi ni khyod dang pha ma dang / /khyod kyi bdun mes rgyud nikyi bar gyi ming yin zhing / /gang tshe khyod ni sangs rgyas 'gyur ba'i ming 'di yin/ /sbyangs rilasdom rnal 'byor ldan pa ci 'dra 'byung 'gyur la/ /khyod sngon yon tan tshul yang 'di 'dra'o bozhes brjod do/ /de skad gang thos rlom sems byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /bdud kyis yongs su bslang zhing blo chung rig par bya/ /rab tu dben pa'i grong dang grong khyer ri sul dang / /dgon pa dben pa nags khrod rab tu sten nyunyabyed cing / /bdag stodamu gzhan la smod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /bdud kyis yongs su bslang hurtezhing blo chung rig par bya / /rtag tu grong dang yul 'khor grong rdal miganas byed cing / /sems can smin byed byang chub brtson pa ma gtogs par/ /de ni dgra bcom rang rgyal 'dod pa gzhan mi skye'i/ /'di ni bde bar gshegs kyi sras kyis 7dben par gsungs / /gang zhig dpag tshad lnga brgya yod pa'i ri yi bul/ /sbrul gyis gang bar lo mang bye bar gnas byed kyang / /dben pa 'di misngo 7shes pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de/ /lhag pa'i nga rgyal rnyed nas 'dre bar gnas pa yin/ /byang 31—29

chub sems dpa' 'gro ba'i don brtson bsam gtan dang / /stobs dang dbang po rnam thar ting 'dzin thob de la/ /'di ni dgon dben spyod pa min snyam brnyas byed pa/ /de ni bdud kyi spyod yul gnas zhes 3)rgyal bas gsungs/ /gang zhig grong ngam 'on te dgon par gnas kyang rung / /theg pa gnyis kyi sems bral byang chub mchog nges na/ /'di ni 'gro don zhugs5 pa rnams kyi5snyedaben pa ste/ /byang chub sems dpa' drod snyom bde ni bdag nyid nyams/ /de lta bas na byang chub dam pa tshol ba yisar/ /bsam pa drag ldan mkhas pasashormeng rgyal nges bcom ste/ /nad pa'i tshogs kyis gso phyir sman pa sten pa ltaralpi/ /g.yel ba med par dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten par bya/ /sangs rgyas byang chub mchog zhugs byang chub sems dpa' dag /pha rol phyin dang bcas te dge ba'i bshes su bsten/ /de dag rjes su ston byed 'di ni bsgrub pa'i sa(〈sna/ /rgyu rnamapo gnyis kyis sangs rgyas byang chub myur du rtogs/ /rgyal ba 'das dang ma byon phyogs bcur 1 gang bzhugs pa/ /kun lam pha rol phyin pa 'di yin gzhan ma yin / /pha rol phyin 'di byang chub mchog la zhugs rnams kyi/ /gsal dang sgron dang snang dang ston mchog yin zhes bshad/ /ji ltar shes rab pha rol phyin pa mtshan nyid stong / /chos 'di thams cad mtshan nyid de dang 'drar shes shing //chos rnams stong zhing mtshan ma med par rab shes na/ /de ltar spyod pa bde gshegs shes rab spyod pa yin/ /sems can yongs su ltogs pa 31zas la 'dod byed cing / /'khor bar chags pa'i yid dang ldan rnams rtag tu 'khor/ /bdag dang bdag gi chos gnyis yang dag min stong ste/ /byis pa7glebadag nyid kyis ni mkha' la mdud 1 pa bor/ /dper na dogs pa'i 'du shes kyis ni dug 34—30

bslang nya)ba/ /dug de khong du song ba med kyang brgyal bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin byis pa bdag dang bdag gir khas len pa/ /bdag der 'du shes yang dag mi rtagaman/skye zhing 'chi kyi/ /ji ltar 'dzin pa de ltar kun nas nyon mongs bstan/ /bdag dang bdag gir mi dmigs rnam par byang bar gsungs/ /'di la gang yang nyon mongs rnam dag 'gyur med par/ /byang chub sems dpas rishes rab pha rol phyin pa rtogs/ /'dzam bu'i gling na sems can ji snyed ma lus pa/ /de dag thams cad byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ /lo stong bye ba mang por sbyin pa byin byas la/ /kun kyang 'gro ba'i don du ri byang chub rgyur bsngo yang / /gang zhig shes rab pha rol phyin mchog 6rimangon brtson pa/ /tha na nyi ma gcig cigs471rjes su 'thun 587byed na/ /de la sbyin pa'i phung pos bsod nams char mi phod / /de phyir g.yel med rtag tu shes rab 'jug par bya/ /shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /snying rje chen po bskyed kyang 9 sems can 'du shes med/ /de tshe mkhas pa 'gro ba kun gyi sbyin gnas 'gyur/ /rtag tu yul 'khor bsod snyoms don yod yongs su spyod/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang 'dir yun ring 8'brel pa yi/ /lha mi ngan song gsum gyi sems can dgrol ba'i phyir/ /lam yangs pha rol sems can khams la ston 'dod pas11/ /nyin mtshan shes rab pha rol phyin la brtson par bya/ /mi zhig sngon chad ma rnyed pa yi rin chen mchog /dus gzhan zhig na rnyed par gyur te dga' ba las/ /rnyed ma thag tu bag med gyur te stor na ni/ /stor bas rin chen mngon 'dod rtag tu sdug bsngal lo/ /de ltar byang chub mchog zhugs rin chen lta bu yi/ /shes rab pha rol phyin la rnal 'byor dor mi bya/ /rin chen rnyed nas blangs te rab tu 34—31

brtson dkris 1)nas/ /myur du 'gro bar byed pa zhi bar 'gyur ba bzhin/ /nyi ma sprin dang bral ba'i 'od zer dra ba can/ /mun nag thibs posnyomun pa thams cad 'joms 'char ba/ /srin bu me khyer srog chags 'byung po thams cad dang //skar ma'i tshogs dang zla ba'i 'od kun zil gyis gnon/ /de bzhin byang chub sems dpa' shes rab pha rol phyin/ /mchog spyod stong pa dang ni mtshan ma med spyod pa/ /mkhas pas lta ba'i thibs po bcom nas 'gro kun dang / /dgra bcom rang rgyal byang chub sems mang zil gyis gnon/ /dper na rgyal po'i bu zhig nor gtong gdon 'dod pa/ /kun gyi gtso bor gyur te mngon par 'gro bya 'os / /'di ni de lta can yang sems can mang dga' byed/ /thabs thob ④gyur te rgyal srid gnas nas (smos ci dgos/ /de ltar shes rab spyod mkhas byang chub sems dpa' yang / /bdud rtsi sbyin par byed cing lha dang mi rnams dga'//'di ni de lta 7na yang sems can mang phan brtson/ /chos kyi rgyal por gnas par gyur nas na smos ci dgos/ /de yi tshe na bdud ni zug rngu ldan par 'gyur/ /mya ngan nyam 9thag sdug bsngal yid mi sna chibade nyam chung 11/ /ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' 'di yid nur gyur 12zhes/ /'jigs pa bstan phyir phyogs rnams sreg 12cing skar mda' gtong / /gang tshe mkhas pa de dag bsam pa dragatsoldan zhing ske/ /nyin mtshan shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i mamachog don lta/ /de tshe lus sems dag ni mkha' 'gro 8bya ltar rgyu/ / /nag po'i rtsa lag rnams kyis glags rnyed ga la 'gyur/ /gang tshe byang chub sems dpa' 'thab dang rtsod gyur cing / /phan tshun mi 'thun nyu khros pa'i sems dang ldan gyur pa/ /de tshe bdud ni dga' zhing mchog tu nyams bder 'gyur/ /de gnyis rgyal ba'i ye shes las ni ring 34—32

'gyur7snyam/ /de gnyis ring du 'gyur7zhing sha za 'dra bar 'gyur/ /gnyi ga rang gi dam bcas nyams par byed par 'gyur/ /snang zhing bzod dang bral la byang chub ga la yod/ /de tshe bdud rnams phyogs dang bcas te dga' bar 'gyur / /lung bstan ma thob byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig gis/ /lung bstan thob la sems khros rtsod pa rtsom byed na/ /tha ba skyon ldan sems kyi skad cig ji snyed pa/ /de snyed bskal par gzhi nas go cha bgo bgos〈miso/ /sangs rgyas bzod pa'i pha rol phyin pas byang chub reg /sems 'di bzang ba min snyam dran pa skyed byed cing / /so sor 'chags par byed cing phyis kyang sdom byed la/ /dga' bar mi byed de7ni sangs rgyas chos 'dir slob/ /gang zhig slob tshe bslab pa gang yang khas mi len/ /slob pa po dang bslab pa'i chos rnams mi dmigs shing / /bslab dang bslab pa ma yin 'di gnyis mi rtog pa/ /de ltar gang slob de ni sangs rgyas chos 'dir slob/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig de lta'i bslab 'di shes/ /de ni gzhan miyang bslab nyams tshul khrims 'chal mi 'gyur / /de ni sangs rgyas chos mnyes7bya phyir 'di la slob/ /de ni bslab lhagashebaslab la mkhas teshedamigs pa med/ /mkhas pa 'od byed rnams kyi57rishes rab de ltar slob/ /dge ba ma yin sems gcig lha )tsam yang skyed71mi byed/ /nyi ma mkha' la 'gro ba'i zer gyis zil gnon pa'i/ /mdun gyi bar snang la ni mun pa mi gnas bzhin/ /shes rab pha rol phyin la bslab par bobyas rnams kyi//pha rol phyin pa thams cad 'dir ni 'dus par 'gyur/ /'jig tshogs lta bar lta ba drug cu gnyis 'dusaspyo ltar/ /de bzhin pha rol phyin pa 'di dag 'dus par gsungs/ /dper na srog gi dbang po 'gags skon dbang po gzhan/ /31—33

gang dag ji snyed yod pa thams cad 'gag par 'gyur/ /de ltar shes rab spyod pa mkhas pa mchog rnams kyi/ /pha rol phyin pa thams cad 'dir ni 'dus par gsungs / /byang chub sems mkhas nyan thos yon tan gang dag dang / /de bzhin rang rgyal yon tan kun la slob byed cing / /de dag de la mi gnas 'dod pa mi skyed 1de/ /'di ni bdag gis bslab bya yin snyam de phyir slob/ /mi ldog byang chub mchog la rab tu zhugs pa yi/ /sems bskyed pa la bsam pa thag pas yi tshogarang ba/ /stong gsum ri rab srang la gzhal bas tshad gzung rung / /rjes su yi rang dge ba de ni de lta min/ /dge ba don gnyer phan 'dod sems can ji snyed pa/ /kun gyi bsod nams phung po la yang yi rang gyurab)/ /de phyir de dag rgyal ba'i yon tan thob gyur nas/ /sdug bsngal zad par bya phyir 'jig rten chos sbyin byed/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig mi rtog chos rnams kun/ /stong dang mtshan ma med dang spros med yongs shes pa/ /de ni shes rab gnyis kyis byang chub tshol mi byed/ /rnal 'byor pa de shes rab pha rol phyin mchog brtson / /nam mkha'i khams de dang ni nam mkha' der 'gal ba/ /yod pa ma yin gang gis kyang ni de ma thob/ /de bzhin shes rab spyod mkhas byang chub sems dpa' yang / /nam mkha' lta bu yin te nye bar zhi brnyuspyod/ /skye bo'i dbus na sgyu sgorima'i skyes bu 'di snyam du/ /skye bo 'di mgu bya snyam mi sems de yang byed/ /rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs rab tu ston par byed mthong yang / /de la lus med sems med ming yang yod ma yin/ /de bzhin shes rab spyod pa nam yang 'di snyam du/ /byang chub rtogs nas 'gro ba yongs su dgrol mi sems/ /skye btsosna tshogs dang ni bya ba mang ldan pa/ /sgyu ma lta bur rin ston kyang rnam par mi rtog 31—34

spyodal/ /dper na sangs rgyas sprul pa sangs rgyas mdzad pa byed/ /byed pa de la dregs pa cung zad skye0)mi 'gyur/ /de bzhin shes rab spyod mkhas byang chub sems dpa' yang / /sprul pa sgyu ma bzhin du bya ba thams cad ston/ /shing mkhan bzo bo mkhas pas skyes pa bud med dang / /'dra ba'i bzo byas de yang bya ba thams cad byed/ /de bzhin shes rab spyod mkhas byang chub sems dpa' yang ske/ /rnam par mi rtog57ye shes bya ba thams cad byed/ /de ltar spyod mkhas rnams la lha tshogs mang po dag /thal mo sbyar ba btud nas phyag kyang 'tshal bar byedal/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams kyi sangs rgyas ji snyed pa'ang / /yon tan bsngags pa'i phreng ba yongs su brjod gepar mdzad/ /gang gā'i klung mnyam zhing na sems can ji snyed pa/ /de kun yongs su brtag pa9)bzung ste bdud gyur la/ /ba spu nyag re las kyang de snyed sprul byas kyang / /de dag kun gyis mkhas la bar chad bya gemi nus/ /rgyu rnam 1)bzhi yis byang chub sems dpa' mkhas stobs ldan/ /bdud bzhis lca )thub par dka' zhing bskyod par mi nus te(7ske/ /stong par gnas dang sems can yongs su mi gtong dang / /ji skad smras bzhin byed dang bde gshegs byin brlabs can/ /de bzhin gshegs yum shes rab pha rol phyin pa 'di/ /'chad tshe byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig mos byed cing / /bsam pa thag pas bsgrub par mngon par brtson byed na/ /des pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la zhugs rig bya/ /chos dbyings de bzhin nyid la gnas par mi 'gyur zhing / /dper na bar snang sprin bzhin gnas pa med par gnas / /rig sngags 'chang ba gnas med mkha'arwa rgyu gnas 'dod pa/ /sngags mthus dus min me tog ldan zhing 3)byin gyis rlobs/ /de ltar spyod pas834—35

byang chub sems dpa' mkhas gsal ba/ /rtogs par byed dang sangs rgyas chos rnams dmigs mi 'gyur/ /'chad par byed dang chos 'dod lta bar byedanyemi dmigs / /'di ni zhi 'dod yon tan dga' ba'i gnas pa yin/ /dgra bcom rnam thar de bzhin gshegs kyi rinam gtogs par/ /gnas pa 'di ni nyan thos rang rgyal bcas pa yi/ /gnas pa zhi ba'i ting 'dzin rab zhi bde ldan pa/ /ji snyed kun gyi mchog dang gong na med pa yin/ /'dab gachags mkha' la gnas kyang ltung bar 'gyur ma yin/ /nya ni chu la gnas kyang 'tshubs te 'chi ba med/ / de ltar byang chub sems dpa' bsam gtan stobs dag gis4)/ /pha rol son pa stong gnas mya ngan 'da' mi 'gyur/ /sems can kun gyi yon tan mchog tu 'gro ba dang / /sangs rgyas ye shes mchog tu rmad byung mchog reg dang / /chos kyi sbyin pa rab mchog dam pa sbyin 'dod gang / /phan mdzad rnams kyi gnas mchog 'di la bston 55par gyis/ /bslab pa 'di ni 'dren pas bslab pa yongs brjod na6/ /bslab pa ji snyed kun gyi mchog dang gong na med/ /mkhas pa gang zhig bslab kun pha rol 'gro 'dod pas/ /sangs rgyas bslab pa shes rab pha rol phyin 'dir slobasamachi/ /'di ni chos gter mchog dang chos mdzod dam pa yin / /sangs rgyas rigs yin 'gro ba'i bde dang skyid pa'i mdzod/ /'das dang ma byon phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten mgon po rnams/ /de dag 'di las 'khrungs kyang chos dbyings zad mi shesarin/ /shing dang 'bras bu me tog nags tshal ji snyed pa/ /de dag thams cad sa las yang dag 'byung zhing 'thon/ /'on kyang sa la zad pa med cing 'phel ba med/ /yongs su mi nyams rnam par mi rtog skyo ba med/ /sangs rgyas sras dang nyan thos rang rgyal lha rnams dang / /34—36

'gro ba kun gyi bde skyid chos rnams ji snyed pa/ /de kun shes rab pha rol phyin pa mchog las byung / /shes rab rnams kyang zad pa med cing 'phel ba med/ /sems can tha ma 'bring dang mchog gyur ji snyed pa/ /de kun ma rig las byung bde bar gshegs pas gsungs/ /rkyen rnams tshogs nas sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor rab tu 'byung / /ma rig 'khrul 'khor de0)ni zad med 'phel ba med/ /ye shes tshul sgo thabs dang rtsa ba ji snyed pa/ /de kun shes rab pha rol phyin pa mchog las byung / /rkyen rnams tshogs nas las kyikhu'akhrul 'khor rab tu 'byung ske/ /shes rab pha rol phyin la zad med 'phel ba med/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig rten cing 'brel 'byung la/ /skye med zad pa med par shes rab 'di shes te/ /nyi ma sprin med 'od zer 'phro bas mun bsalar ltar/ /ma rig thibs po bcom nas rang byungakhethob par 'gyur/ /mthu chen ldan pa bsam gtan bzhis kyang gnas byed la/ /rten par byed pa ma yin gnas par byed pa med / /'on kyang bsam gtan yan lag bcas pa bzhi po 'di/ /byang chub dam pa mchog thob pa yi rten du 'gyur/ /shes rab mchog thob bsam gtan dag la gnas pa ni/ /gzugs med ting 'dzin dam pa bzhi yang nyams su myong //bsam gtan 'di dag byang chub dam pa mchog la phan/ /byang chub sems dpa' zag pa zad phyir slob pa min/ /'di ni yon tan stsogasalgepa'i ngo mtshar rmad byung ste/ /bsam gtan ting nge 'dzin la gnas nas mtshan ma med/ /de la gnas rnams gal te lus ni zhig gyur nadu/ /bsam pa ji bzhin 'dod pa'i khams su yang skye'o/ /dper na 'dzam gling mi zhig sngon chad lha yul gyi/ /lha yi grong khyer mchog tu ma phyin phyis song ste/ /de nilo yongs su bzung ba'i yul de 31—37

rnams mthong nas/ /phyir 'dir 'ong bar tu gyur na chags par mi byed ltar/ /de bzhin byang chub sems dpa'i 3)yon tan mchog 'chang ba/ /rnal 'byor brtson te bsam gtan ting 'dzin la gnas nas/ /phyir yang 'dod pa'i khams su gnas te chags pa med/ / chu yi gepad+ma bzhin du byis pa'i chos mi gnas/ /bdag nyid chen po sems can yongs su smin bya dang / /zhing sbyong5gepha rol phyin rdzogs don byed kho nar zad/ /byang chub yon tan pha rol phyin nyams 'gyur 'ong zhes/ /gzugs med khams su skye ba gedon du gnyer mi byed/ /dper na mi zhig rin chen gter rnams rnyed gyur nas/ /de la 'dod pa'i blo ni bskyed par nem byas la/ /des kyang dus gzhan zhig na de dag yongs blangs geshing / /blangs nas khyim du song ste chags par mi byed ltar/ /de bzhin byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pa dga' ba dang / /bde sbyin bsam gtan ting 'dzin zhi ba du bzhi thob nas/ /bsam gtan bde ldan bsam gtan ting 'dzin thob btang spuste / /'gro la snying brtser ldan pa nyu riphyir yang 'dod khams 'jug /gal te byang chub sems dpa' ting 'dzin bsam gtan gnas/ /dgra bcom rang rgyal theg par 'dod pa'i blo skyed na 1/ /mnyam par ma bzhag rgod cing sems g.yengs gyur pa ste/ /sangs rgyas yon tan yongs nyams mnyan pa gru zhig bzhin/ /gzhan yang gzugs dang sgra dang de bzhin dri dang ro/ /reg dang 'dod yon lnga la mngon par 12brtson gyur kyang / /dgra bcom rang rgyal theg bral byang chub sems dga' na/ /dpa' bo rtag tu mnyam gzhag nya yin par shes par bya/ /sems can gang zag gzhan 7phyir sems dpa' gernam dag pa/ /brtson 'grus pha rol phyin la mngon brtson rnam par spyod/ /dper na bran mo chu michun dbang 31—38

med rje7bo'i dbang / /de bzhin dpa' rnams sems can kun gyi dbang gis 'grol/ /spyo ba byas sam 'on te rtag tu brdegasatshwa kyang rung / /bran mo rje gebo la ni zlogabotshig mi smra yi/ /'di yis bdag ni ④bsad par 'gyur du 'ong snyam nas / /shin tu skrag pa'i yid kyis 'jigs bcas zil gyis gnon/ /de bzhin byang chub ched du byang chub mchog zhugs pa/ /'gro ba kun la bran gyur bzhin du gnas par bya/ /'di las byang chub thobapo)cing yon tan rdzogs par 'gyur/ /rtswa dang shing las me byung bas ni de nyid sreg57 /bdag gi 3)bde ba btang nas re ba med sems kyis/ /sems can gzhan gyi dgos la nyin mtshan mngon par brtson / /bu gcigashepa la ma ni rim gro byed pa ltar/ /bsam pa thag pas rnam par skyo med gnas par gyis/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig yun ring 'khor 'dod cing / /sems can don dang zhing sbyong brtson pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /skyo ba'i blo ni rdul tsam skye bar mi 'gyur na/ /de ni brtson 'grus pha rol phyin ldan g.yel ba med/ /byang chub sems dpa' mi mkhas bskal 7pa bye ba bgrang / /gal te ring bar 'du shes sdug bsngal byang chub sgrub/ /yang dag chos sgrub byed tshe yun ring sdug bsngal 'gyur/ / des ni 37brtson 'grus pha rol phyin nyams le lo can/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed dang po nas bzung ste/ /byang chub bla na med pa thob par 'gyur gyi bar/ /nyin mtshan gcig tsam du ni yid la sems byed na/ /mkhas pa gsal bas brtson 'grus brtsams par rig par bya/ /gal te 'ga' zhig 'di skad ri rab ri bshig 12pa'i/ /rjes la byang chub mchog thob 'gyur zhes smra ba las/ /ci ste skyo ba'i blo skyed tshad kyang sems byed na/ /de tshe byang chub sems dpa' le lor gyur pa yin/ /ji /lhaste de ni 'di tsam tshod 31—39

lta ci dka' zhes/ /skad ①cig tsam la ri rab thal bar rlag sems bskyedage/ /byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pa ri brtson 'grus brtsams pa ste/ /ring por mi thogs 'dren pa'i byang chub mchog thob 'gyur/ /'gro ba yongs su smin par byas nas don bya zhes/ /gal te lus dang ngag dang yid kyis brtson byed na/ /bdag tu 'du shes gnas pas le lor gyur pa ste/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid las 4riring 'gyur gnam sa bzhin/ /gang tshe lus dang sems dang sems can 'du shes med/ /'du shes rnam par log nas gnyis su med chos spyod⑤/ /'di ni byang chub zhi ba mi nyams mchog 'dod pa'i/ /brtson 'grus pha rol phyin ces phan pa mdzad pas gsungs/ /gal te gzhan las ngan brjod tshig rtsub thos gyur na / /bdag bde yin zhes byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pa dga'/ /su smra sus thos gang gis gang zhig gang gi rdzi)phyir/ /bzod pa'i pha rol phyin mchog ldan pa mdzangs 7pa yin/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig bzod pa'i legs chos ldan/ /gang zhig stong gsum rin chen bkang dusaste 'jig rten mkhyen/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang dgra bcom rang rgyal phul byas pa'ikhya/ /sbyin pa'i phung pos de la bsod nams char mi phod/ /bzod la gnas pa'i lus ni yongs su dag 'gyur te/ /sum cu nyu rtsa gnyis mtshan dang mthu stobs pha mtha' yas/ /sems can rnams la chos rab stong pa sgrogs /1par byed/ /'di ni bzod ldan de la 'gro ba dga' tsho 'gyur mkhas/ /gal te sems can la las tsan dan phur ma blangs/ /rab gus byang chub sems dpa' la ni nyug byed la/ /gzhan zhig me mdag mgo la 'thor byed gnyi ga la/ /de yis mnyam zhing snyoms pa'i yid ni bskyed par bya/ /byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pas nyunyede ltar bzod byas nas/ /34—40

sems bskyed de ni byang chub mchog tu yongs bsngos na/ /dpa' bo 'jig rten kun la bzod pas dgra bcom dang / /rang rgyal sems can khams mang tshiji snyed zil gyis gnon/ /bzod byed 'di snyam du yang sems ni bskyedango bya ste/ /sems dmyal dud 'gro gshin rje'i 'jig rten sdug bsngal mang / /'dod pa'i yon tan rgyu yis dbang med gnod myong na/ /byang chub ched du ci phyir da bzodadza mi bya snyam/ /lcag dbyig mtshon⑧dang gsadapo)dang bcing rinadang brdeg pa dang //mgo gcod pa dang rna ba rkang57)lag sna gcod dang / /'jig rten sdug bsngal ji snyed bdag gis bzod snyam pa/ /byang chub sems dpa' bzod pa'i pha rol phyin la gnas/ /tshul khrims kyis ni zhi ba 'dod rnams 'phags par 'gyur3)/ /stobs bcu'i spyod yul gnas shing tshul khrims nyams pa med/ /sdom pa'i bya ba ji snyed kun gyi rjes su 'jug /sems can kun la phan phyir de yang byang chub bsngo / /gal te dgra bcom rang rgyal byang chub reg 'dod na/ /tshul khrims 'chal cing mi mkhas de bzhin spyod pa nyams/ /ci ste byang chub zhi ba mchog tu yongs bsngo na/ /'dod yon brtson yang tshul khrims pha rol phyin la gnas/ /chos gang nges pa'i byang chub yon tan 'byung 'gyur ba/ / 'di ni 37yon tan chos ldan rnams kyi tshul khrims don/ /chos gang phan byed rnams kyi byang chub yongs nyams pa/ /'di ni tshul khrims 'chal ces rnam par 'dren pas gsungs//gal te byang chub sems dpa' 'dod yon lnga spyod kyang / /sangs rgyas chos dang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun skyabs song ste/ /sangs rgyas 'grub bya snyam du kun mkhyen yid byed na/ /mkhas pa tshul khrims pha rol phyin gnas rig par bya/ /gal te bskal pa bye bar dge ba'i las lam bcu/ /spyod kyang dgra bcom rang 34—41

rgyal 1nyid la 'dod skyed rinan/ /de tshe tshul khrims skyon byung tshul khrims nyamasasnyepa yin/ /sems bskyed de ni phas pham pas kyang shin tu lci/ /tshul khrims srung zhing byang chub mchog tu yongs bsngo la/ /de yis rlom sems med cing bdag bstod mi byed la/ /ngam moyi 'du shes sems can 'du shes yongs su spangs/ /byang chub sems dpa' tshul khrims pha rol phyin gnas brjod/ /gal te byang chub sems dpa' rgyal ba'i lam spyod pa/ /sems can 'di dag khrims ldan 'di dag khrims 'chal zhes snye/ /sna tshogs 'du shes zhugs pa shin tu tshul khrims 'chal/ /tshul khrims nyams shing de la yongs dag tshul khrims med/ /gang la bdag gi 'du shes sems can 'du shes med/ /'du shes 'dod chags bral la sdom min ga la yod/ /gang la sdom dang sdom pa ma yin rlom sems med/ /'di ni tshul khrims sdom par rnam par 'dren pas gsungs/ /sems can dag pa gang zhig de ltar khrims ldan pa/ /sdug dang mi sdug kun la lta ba med pa yin/ /mgo dang rkang lag gtong zhing zhum pa'i sems kyang med/ /bdog pa thams cad gtong zhing rtag tu zhen pa med/ /chos rnams rang bzhin bdag med ya ma brlar shes nas ske/ /bdag gi sha yang gtong zhing 7zhum pa'i sems med na/ /de tshe phyi rol dngos po gtong ba smos ci dgos/ /gal te ser sna byed pa de ni gnas med do/ /bdag tu 'du shes dngos la bdag gir 'dzin pas chags/ /blun po rnams la gtong ba'i blo lta ga la yod/ /ser sna can ni yi dgas 33gnas su skye bar 'gyur/ /ci ste mir skyes na yang de tshe dbul por 'gyur/ /de tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems can dbul shes nas/ /gtong la mos par 'gyurawezhing rtag tu lhug par gtong ske/ /gling bzhi legs par brgyan 3 pa mchil ma'i thal ba 'dra/ /byin 3134—42

nas dga' bar 'gyur gyi0)gling thob de lta min/ /byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pa gsal ba srid gsum gyini/ /sems can ji snyed de dag kun la sbyin 4)pa 'di / /byin par gyur cigashesnyam du bsams7nas sbyin byin (7)la/ /de yang 'gro ba'i don phyir byang chub mchog tu bsngo/ /sbyin pa byin nas dngos la gnas param byed pa med/ /de ni nam du'ang rnam par smin la re ba med/ /de ltar gtong la mkhas pa thams cad gtong 3)ba ste/ /chung hu )ngu btang la mang po dpag tu med par 'gyur/ /srid pa gsum na sems can ma lus ji snyed pa/ /yongs su brtag pa stobazung ste de dag thams cad kyis/ /'jig rten mkhyen pa sangs rgyas dgra bcom rang rgyal la/ /bskal pa mtha' yas sbyin byin nyan thos legs tshol na/ /byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pa thabs mkhas gang zhig gis/ /de dag bsod nams bya ba'i dngos la yi rang nas/ /sems can don du byang chub mchog rab yongs bsngo na/ /yongs su bsngos pasatshwa 'gro ba thams cad zil gyis gnon / /nor bu mching nya bu'i phung po chen 1 por gyur pa yang / /rin chen bai ḍūr+ya gcigasade kun zil gyis nya༄gnon/ /de bzhin 'gro kun sbyin pa'i phung po rgya hu tshochen kun/ /rjes su yi rang byang chub sems dpas nya zil gyis gnon1tshe / /gal te byang chub sems dpas gi ci'agro la sbyin byin nas/ /de la bdag gir mi byed dngos po phangs 31med na/ /de las dge ba'i rtsa ba mthu 22chen 'phel 'gyur te / /sprin med 'od ldan zla dkyil yar gyi ngo bzhin no/ / skabs drug pa mthar gyis pa bstan/(rte byang chub sems dpa'i sbyin pas yi dgas 3ge'agro ba gcod/ /dbul nanib dang ni de bzhin nyon mongs thams cad gcod/ /spyod tshe longs spyod mtha' yas rgyas pa thob par ni 'gyur/ /sbyin pas sdug bsngal gyur pa'i sems can 34wa 43

yongs smin byed/ /khrims kyis 3)dud 'gro'i 'gro ba du ma'i ngo bo dang / /mi khom brgyad spong de yis dal ba rtag tu rnyed/ /bzod pas gzugs bzang dam pa rgya chen thob 'gyur te/ /gser mdog sdug cing 'gro bas ltakhuba'i 'os su 'gyur / /brtson 'grus kyis ni dkar po'i yon tan 'grib mi 'gyur/ /ye shes mtha' yas rgyal ba'i 5 zhibang mdzod rnyed par 'gyur/ /bsam gtan gyis ni 'dod pa'i yon tan smad pa 'dor/ /rig dang mngon par shes dang ting 'dzin mngon par sgrub/ /shes rab kyis ni chos kyi rang bzhin yongs shes nas/ /khams gsum ma lus pa las yang dag 'da' bar 'gyur/ / mi yishekhu mchog 'khor lo rin chen bskor byas nas/ /sdug bsngal zad par bya phyir 'gro la chos kyang ston/ / skabs bdun pa skad cig ma gcig la mngon par rdzogs par byang chub par bstan/ma chos 'di yongs rdzogs byas nas byang chub sems dpa' de/ / skabs brgyad pa chos kyi sku bstan/⑥yongs dag zhing dang sems can dag pa yongs su 'dzin/ /sangs rgyas rgyud dang chos kyi rgyud kyang yongs su 'dzin/ /de bzhin dge 'dun rgyud dang chos kun yongs su 'dzin/ /'gro ba'i nad gso 7mdzad pa sman pa'i mchog gyur pas/ /shes rab bstan pa byang chub lam ldan 'di gsungs te/ /ming ni yon tan rin chen sdud pa byang chub lam/ /lam 'di sems can kun gyis thob par bya phyir bshad / /'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sdud pa tshigs su bcad ⑧pa rdzogs sto9// // ngargya gar gyi mkhan po bibyā /ka ra sing ha huskredang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de nyugedapal brtsegs kyis bsgyur ri 1 cing zhus te gtan cil phab pathege yi34—44

༄ga /'phags pa rab kyi rtsal gyis rnam par gnon pas zhus pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bstan pa/37༄dzi /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya su bi kran ta bi kra ma pa ri tsusgromatsho nipradzñā pā ra mi ta nir ri cide sha /bod skad du/ 'phags pa rab kyi rtsal gyis rnam par gnon pas zhus pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bstan pa/ bam po dang po/sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / 'phags pa nyan thos thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da 4 ka gnas pa na/ dge slong stong nyis brgya lnga bcu'i dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sangs rgyas kyi zhing tha dad pa nas 'dus pa skye ba gcig gis thogs pa tshad med grangs med pa dang thabs cig ri tu bzhugs te/de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das 'khor brgya stong du mas yongs su bskor cing mdun gyis bltas 6te chos ston to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen 34—54

po rab kyi rtsal ①gyis rnam par gnon pa zhes bya ba 'khor de nyid du 'dus par gyur nas 'dug pa de stan (gyelas langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar du nanas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de ④logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to//gal te zhus nas zhu ba lung bstan pa'i slad du bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag la skabs phye na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la bdagasaphyogs 'ga' zhig zhu lags so/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang ske/ bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rab kyi rtsal gyis rnam par gnon pa la 'di skad ces bka' stsal56)to/ /rab kyi rtsal gyis rnam par gnon pa3)/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la khyod ci dang ci 'dod pa dris shig dang / dris pa de dang de'i lung bstan pas khyod kyi sems rangs par bya'o/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rab kyi rtsal gyis rnam par gnon pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bgyi bsngasheX/bcom ldan 'das ji tsam gyis na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi tsoshes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bgyi(sto/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgom hurtepa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur /snyelags/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na 34—55

byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgom pa na bdud sdig can gyis glags mi rnyed cing bdud kyi las thams cad kyang rtogs par 'gyur sna)lags/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas pa ji lta bus gnas na myur du thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi chos rnams7yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ①lags/de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rab kyi rtsal gyis rnam par gnon pa la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rab kyi rtsal gyis rnam par gnon pa khyod byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi don dang / ci nas khyod skye bo mang po la phan pa dang ske/ skye bo mang po la bde ba dang / 'jig rten la snying brtse ba dang / lha dang mi rnams kyi skye bo phal po che'i don dang phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir zhugs shing ske/ da ltar gyi dang / ma 'ongs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la snang bar0byed par 'dod pas de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'dri ba legs so legs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis mkhyen bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rab kyi rtsal gyis rnam par gnon pa la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rab kyi rtsal gyis rnam par gnon pa khyod don gyi dbang gang mthong nas de bzhin gshegs pa la don 'di lta bu 'dri/ de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rab kyi rtsal gyis rnam par gnon pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das sems can thams cad la sman pa dang / sems can thams 31—56
