dang ske/ 'ong ba shin tu nye bas sangs rgyas la 'os pa'i gnas lags ①pas bzhes par zhu/ desalgegaser gyi ril ba spyi blugs la me tog gi dris bsgos te/nor bu'i kha dog can gyi chu blangs nas du'od ma'i tshal yongs su gtong zhing stobs dubacu pa'i phyag tu chu steng dunas/ der kun dga' ra ba bzhes nas sangs rgyas kyi7bstan pa'i gzhi zhes brjod cing sa gzhi chen po g.yos so/ /'dzam bu'i nigling gi nang nas 'od ma'i tshal spangs pa'i sa gzhi g.yos pa 'di bzhes te sde7gzhan ni med do/ /si gha gling gi gtsug lag khang chen po spangs nas sa gzhi chen po5tegayos pa 'di bzhes te/ sde gzhan ni7med do/ /ston pas 'od ma'i tshal gyi kun dga' ra ba bzhes nas rgyal po la rjes su yi rang bar mdzad cing stan lasachabazhengs te/ dge slong gi dge 'dun 'khor du byas nas 'od ma'i tshal du byon no/ /de'i tshe de'i dus na shā ri'i bu dang / mod gal gyi bu kun du rgyu gnyis po rgyal po'i khab la brten nas gnas shing bdud rtsi tshol bar sems so/ /de'i nang nas shā ri'i bus gnas brtan7rta thul bsod snyoms la zhugs pa mthong bas sems rab tu dngas par gyur tu 7te bza' ba byin nas chos rnams gang dag rgyu las byung ba dang zhes pa'i tshigs bcad thos pas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob par gyur to/ /rang gi grogs po kun du rgyu mod galanyel yang tshigs su bcad pa de nyid smras so/ /des kyang rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob bo/ /de gnyis kyis kyang rang nyid rgyal ba la bltas nas rang gi 'khor dang bcas pa ston pa'i drung du rab tu byung ngo / /de rnams las mod gal5)gyi bu chen po zhag bdun nas dgra bcom pa thob bo/ /gnas brtan shā ri'i bus zla ba phyed nas dgra bcom pa thob ste de gnyis po yang ston pa'i nyan thos kyi mchog 34—676

tu gnas par bzung7ngo / /gnas brtan shā ri'i bus dgra bcom pa thob pa'i nyin mo nyid bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos kyi 'dus pa dang por byas so/ /slar yang de bzhin gshegs pas 'od ma'i tshal de nyid du ②bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe rgyal po chen po zas gtsang gis bdag gi sras lo drug tu dka' ba spyad dunas mchog gi yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub ste/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas rgyal po'i khab kyi 'od ma'i tshal du bzhugs so zhes pa thos nas blon po phan tshun rnams bos te 'dir shog cig skyes bu stong phrag gcig gis 'khor khrid de rgyal po'i khab tu song la nga'i tshig gis khyed kyi ④yab rgyal po ⑧zas gtsang khyed blta bar 'dod ces brjod pas bdag gi sras khrid la shog ces smras so/ /blon pos kyang lha de bzhin du bgyi'o zhes rgyal po'i gsung spyi bos blangs nas skyes bu stong phrag gcig gi 'khor de khrid de myur ba nyid du dpag tshad drug cu'i lam du song nas stobs bcu ⑩pa 'khor bzhi'i nang du bzhugs nas chos ston pa'i dus su gtsug lag khang du zhugs (7so/ /de rgyal pos btang ba'i don re zhig bzhag nas 'khor thams cad kyi mthar 'khod de ston pa'i chos bstan pa thos nas ji ltar 'khod pa nyid bzhin du skyes bu stong phrag gcig dang lhan cig tu dgra bcom pa thob nas rab tu 'byung bar zhugasarwanyeso/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis btsun7pa rnams 'dir shog cigacaces phyag brkyang7ngo / /thams cad de nyid du rdzu 'phrul las byung ba'i lhung bzed dang chos gos gsum bzung nas/ lo brgya lon pa'i gnas brtan lta bur gyur to/ /dgra bcom pa thob pa'i dus nas bzung ste/slar yang 'phags pa zhes bya ba re zhig bar mar gnas par gyur to/ /rgyal pos btang ba'i spring yig stobs bcu pa la ma brjod do/ /rgyal pos btang ba'i mi 34—677

rnams las gcig kyang ma byung zhing spring yig kyang ma thos so/ /'dir shog la khyed song zhigatudang de lta bu'i nges pas blon po gzhan gcig btang ngo / /des song nas yang sngar bzhin du 'khor dang bcas pa dgra bcom pa thob nas cang mi gsungakhubar gnas so/ /rgyal pos de lta bur nges pas skyes bu stong phrag re re'i 'khor dang bcas pa'i blon po dgu btang ngo / /thams cad rang gi don rdzogs par byas nas cang mi smra bar gyur te de nyid du gnas so/ /rgyal pos spring yig tsam gyi lo rgyus kyang ma thob po zhes bsamasalgenas mi 'di rnams nga la mi dga' ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis spring yig tsam gyi lo rgyus kyang mi brjod do/ /su zhig nga'i tshig bzhin byed par sems/ rgyal pos mi thams cad la brtags pas nag po 'char ka mthong ngo / /de yang rgyal po'i don thams cad sgrub par byed pa'i blon po yinasnyino nang mi yin no/ /shin tu thugs ches pa yin no/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dang lhan cig la nyin gcig tu skyes pa yin no/ /de dang lhan cig tu brtsesaba'i grogs po yin no/ /de nas blon po rgyal pos bos te/ bu nag po 'char ka bdag gi sras blta bar 'dod pas skyes bu dustong phrag dgu btang ste mi gcig kyang ma ⑦'ongs nas spring yig tsam gyi lo nirgyus ci yang ma byung / slar yang thams cad nad kyis thebs pa yin nam tshe'i ⑨bar chad du gyur pa yin nam/bdag 'tsho ba nyid kyi bar du sras po blta7 bar 'dod de bdag gi bu blta7bar nus sam zhes smras so/ /lha nus lags so/ /gal te rab tu phyung yang blta bar nus so/ /bu khyod rab tu byung ba'am ma byung yang / nga sras po blta'o zhes smras so / /des lha legs so zhes rgyal po'i gsung blangs nas rgyal po'i khab tu song ste/ston pa chos ston pa'i dus su 'khor rnams kyi mthar 'khod de chos thos nas 34—678

'khor dang bcas pa dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu thob par gyur te dge slong gi dngos por so sor gnas so/ /ston pa sangs rgyas su gyur nas dang po'i lo la drang srong lhung ba'i gnas su dbyar bzhugs te/ dgagatudabye byas nas lteng〈 shergyas su gshegs shing der zla ba gsum bzhugs te/ ral ba can spun rnams btulashenas dge slong stong phrag gcig gi 'khor dang bcas pa dgun zla 'bring po'i nya la rgyal po'i khab tu gshegs nas zla ba gnyis〈pebazhugs so/ /de rnams ni grong khyer bā rā ṇa sī nas 'ongs pa'i bar te6)/ zla ba lnga song zhing dgun gyi dus thams cad 'das so/ /gnas57brtan 'char ka 'ongs nas zhag bdun dang brgyad song ngo / /des dpyid zla ra ba'i nya la bsams pa/ dgun gyi dus 'das nas dpyid ku'i ⑧dus su lasleb pa dang / mi rnams kyis 'bru rnams blangs te/ phyogs phyogs nas lam du byung bas rtswa rnams ljang gur gyur to/ /sa gzhi dang nags tshal gyi shing la sogs7)pa me tog5geshin tu mang ba kha bye ba ni lam du 'gro ba'i7dus so/ /stobs bcu pa'i nye du dang phrad par byed pa'i lamachadu 'gro ba'i dus yin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi 8drung du nye bar song nas/ btsun pa ljon shing de ni ljang gur gyur/ /shing gi lo ma sa la dud pa podang rka/ /de rnams bar nas 'od zer 'gyed pa yin/ /dpa' bo chen po gnyen gnas gshegs pa'i dus/ /ha cang mi dro mi grang zhing / /mu ge dang ni bkres pa med/ /sa steng shing rnams ljang gur gyur/ /thub pa chen po dus 'dir gyur⑩/ /tshigs su bcad pa drug cu tsam gyis stobs bcu pa la rigs kyi grong khyer du gshegs pa'i phyir bsngags par 'os pa'i bsngags pa brjod pa'o/ /de nas ston pa la 'char gas7dbyangs snyan pos gshegs pa'i bsngags par 'os 34—679

pa'i bsngags pa gsungs so/ /btsun pa khyed kyi yab rgyal po chen po zas gtsang blta bar 'dod pas nye du rnams rjes su 'dzin par zhu/ legs so 'char ka nye du rnams rjes su gzung ①bar bgyi'o/ /zhes dge slong gi dge 'dun la smros shig② /gshegs pa'i gnas thams cad la byi dor gyis shig ces smros shig /btsun pashelegs so zhes gnas brtan⑧song nas smras soX/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis yul o gha dang ma ga bsnyun gnas pa'i rigs kyi bu rnams stong phrag bcu dang bcas pa grong khyer ser skya'i gzhi na ⑧gnas pa'i stong phrag bcu po thams cad zag pa zad pa'ishedage slong 'khor du byas nas rgyal po'i khab nas phyi rol du 'thon te/ nyi ma re re la dpag tshad re re bgrod cing rgyal po'i khab nas dpag tshad drug cu'i 1 )grong khyer ser skya'i gzhir zla ba gnyis kyis sleb par dgongs shing bul ba yang ma yin myur ba yang ma yin par 'bring por gshegs so/ /gnas brtan gyis kyang bcom ldan 'das byon no zhes rgyal po'i drung du smra'o zhes bsams hunyenas nam mkha' la song ste rgyal po'i gnas su sleb par gyur to/ /rgyal pos hunyeganas brtan gzigs nas thugs tshim par gyur te/ gdan bshams pa la bzhugs su bcug go/ /rang la byed pa bzhin bcos nas ro sna tshogs pa'i bza' bas lhung bzed bkang nas phul lo/ /gnas brtan langs nas 'gro bar tsobasams pa dang / bu bzhugs la gsol cig /rgyal po chen po7ston pa dang nye bar song ste bza'o/ /slar yang bu ston pa ga na yod/ stong phrag nyi shu'i dge slong 'khor du byas nas rgyal po chen po nyid blta ba'i phyir byon no/ /rgyal po thugs tshim par gyur nas smras pa/ khyed 'di gsol la bdag gi sras7grong khyer 'dir ma byon gyi bar la 'di nyid nas lhung bzed du bza' ba khyer la song cig 31—680

ces smras so/ /gnas brtan gyis7rgyal po'i gsung mnyan te rgyal pos gnas brtan gyisabaza' ba gsol zin pa dang lhung bzed bkrus nas/ dri bzang po'ishephye mas byugs te bza' ba mchog gis gang bar byas nas de bzhin gshegs pa la phul cig zhes smras nas gnas brtan gyi lag par byin no/ /gnas brtan mi thams cad kyis mthong ba dang lhung bzed nam mkha' la 'phangasalgebo rang nyid kyang nam mkha' la gshegs nas bza' ba'i lhung bzed bzung ste/ ston pa'i phyag tu phul nas ston pas kyang der bza' ba la longs spyod dol/ /gnas brtan thabs 'di'i⑧nyi ma re re bzhin du bza' ba phul lo/ /ston pas kyang lam gyi bar du rgyal po nyid kyi7gdugs tshod la longs spyod do/ /gnas brtan gyis kyang gdugs tshod la longs spyod pa'i mthar tu)nyi ma re re bzhin du de ring 'di tsam nas bcom ldan 'das byon no/ /de ring 'di tsam du bcom ldan 'das byon zhes pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi yon tan yang dag par ldan pa nyid brjod7cing rgyal ris7thams cad ston pa ma mthong ba nyid kyis ston pa'i drung du rang nyid kyi sems dngasalgepar mdzad do/ /de'i rgyu mtshan gyis gnas brtan la bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong dag bdag gi nyan thos kyi nang nas rigs dad par byed pa rnams kyi mchog gang yin na 'di ni 'char ka zhes pa'o/ /'di mchog tu bzungatsobs shākya ba rnams kyis kyang bcom ldan 'das rjes su byonasnyipa'i sngun la bdag cag gi 7nye du'i gtso bo blta'o zhes 'dus nas bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa'i gnas rtog tunyecing shākya n+ya gro dha'i kun dga' ra ba yid du 'ong ba sta gon byas so/ /der thams cad nyer bsdogs77byas nas spos dang me tog ⑥so so lag tu thogs te/ bsu ba byed cing rgyan thams cad kyis so sor 31—681

brgyan nas gzhon nu nyu)dang gzhon nu ②ma grong khyer gyi khye'u dang bu mo sngar dang por btang ba rnams dang / de nas rgyal po'i gzhon nu dang gzhon nu ma dag de rnams kyi bar rang rang zhugis spos dang me togasnyidang phye ma la sogasalgepas mchod pa byed cing / bcom ldan 'das kyis bzhes nas rgyas0gro dha'i kun dga' ra ba nyid du byon no/ /der bcom ldan 'das kyis stong phrag nyi shu'i zag pa zad pa'i dge slong 'khor du byas nas gdan bshams pa mchog la sangs rgyas bzhugs so/ /shākya'i rigs ni nga rgyal dang ldan pa yin/ sems rtsub pa yin pas 'di ni don grub gzhon nu nged dang lhan cig gzhon nu yin no/ /nged ni phu bo yin no/ / 'di ni sring mo'i bu yin no/ /du'adi ni tsha bo yin no zhes bsams nas khye'u dang rgyal po'i gzhon nu zhes smras te/ khyed kyi phyag gis bdag khyed kyi rgyab tu sdodapo)do zhes bsams so/ /de rnams de bzhin du gnas nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de rnams kyi bsam pa gzigs nas gnyen rnams bdag la phyag mi byed par 'dod kyang da lta tsho/3 phyag byed du gzhug tunyedagos te/ mngon par shes pa'i gzhi dang ye shes dang bsam gtan dang snyoms〈rtepar 'jug pa bskyed dgos sol snyam ste/ bzhengs nas nam mkha' la gshegs7so/ /de rnams kyi mgo la zhabs kyi rdul lhung ba mabazhin du a mra srung 8ba'i a mra'i tunyeshing gi drung du so so'i cho 'phrul dang mtshungs par cho 'phrul mdzad do/ /rgyal pos de'i〈nyeya mtshan che ba mthong ngo zhes smras so/ /bcom ldan 'das khyed 'khrungs pa'i nyin mo ⑪dka' thub pa nag po lha len gyis phyag byed cing nye bar gnas pas khyed kyis zhabs bskyod pa bram ze'i spyi bo la nye bar gnas so/ /de mthong nas bdag gis kyang khyed la phyag byas so/ /'di ni bdag gi bu phyag dang po yin no/ /bkra shis 34—682

pa'i 'bru 'debs pa'i nyin mo 'dzam bu'i7shing gi grib ma'i dpal gyi mal stan la khyed bzhugs pa nakhushing 'dzam bu'ishegrib mas ma btang bar mthong ba'i tshe yang zhabs la phyag byas so/ /'di ni bdag gi〈phyag gnyis pa yin no/ /da lta ni bdag gis sngar ma mthong ba'i cho 'phrul yang mthong bas khyed kyi zhabs (gyel phyag bgyid do/ /'di ni bdag gi phyag gsum pa yin no/ /slar yang rgyal pos bcom ldan 'das la phyag byed cing phyag byed par mi nus pa'i shākya'i rigs gcig kyang med do/ /thams cad kyis7kyang phyag byed pa nyid do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la nye du rnams kyis phyag byed cing nam mkha' las babs nas gdan bshams pa'i mchog gi gung la bzhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das bzhugs nas nye du rnams dang 'dus par gyur pa la7thams cad sems gcig tu gnas so/ /de nas sprin chen po las pad ma'i 'dabasnyem la chu mi 'chags pa lta bu'i char 'bebs so/ /chu zangs kyi mdog〈nyecan sa la sgra sgrogs shing 'bab bo /'bang 8bar 'dod pa rnams 'bang ngo / /'bang bar mi 'dod pa rnams mi 'bang ngo / /thigs pa tsam yang mi lhung ngo / /de mthong nas thams cad du yalgematshan pa dang rmad du byung ba skyes so/ /e ma ho ngo mtshar che/ e ma ho rmad du byung ngo zhes rjod7par byed do/ /ston pas 'di kho na ma yin gyi bdag gi nye du dang phrad pa na pad ma'i 'dab 8ma la 8chu mi 'chags pa lta bu'i char 'bebs shing 'das pa'i dus su'ang ngas phab bo/ /'di'i don byung ba ni thams cad sgrol gyi skyes rabs su bshad do/ /chos bstan7pa thos nas thams cad langs te phyag byas nas song ngo / /gcig〈rtegis kyang rgyal po dang rgyal tshab dang blon po rnams sang bdag gi gnas su bsod snyoms khyer 'ong ngo zhes smra ba song bsngo kye de 34—683

rnams las gcig kyang ma byung ngo / /ston pas slar nyi ma gnyis pa la stong phrag nyi shu'i dge slong 'khor du byas nas grong khyer ser skya'i gzhir bsod snyoms la bzhud do/ /gang zhig mgronanyedu gnyer bsnyedang / ②lhung bzed khyer ba su yang med do/ /bcom ldan 'das sgo drung du 'khod de rnam par brtags pas ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyi rigs kyi grong khyer du byon nas bsod snyoms mdzad pa bzhin du gang ji ltar rigs par mi chen po'i khyim du 'gro zhing yang na go rimasashebazhin du bsod snyoms spyod do/ /de nas sangs rgyas gcig gis kyang ji ltar rigs par gshegs pa ma mthong bas bdag gisasakyang nga ni 'di'i rigs so/ /'di sngon gyi sangs rgyas kyi rigs bzhin du bdag gis kyang rigs par gzung7bar bya'o/ /bdag gi nyan thos kyang bdag nyid bzhin rjes su slobashecing bsod snyoms la rdzogs par byon no/ /'khod pa'i khyim nas bzungasnyenas go rims 6)bzhin du bsod snyoms la spyod do/ /'phags pa gzhon nu don grub bsod snyoms la gshegs so zhes brjod do/ /nyis thog dang sum thog la sogs7pa'i khang bzangs7rnams su steng gi sgo chung phye nas mi thams cad blta bar gyur te lha mo sgra gcan tunye'adzin gyi yum yang 'phags pa'i bu grong khyer 'di nyid du rgyal po chen po'i mthus gser gyi do li la sogasalgepa la zhon te de ring nas skra dang kha spu bregs shing ngur smrig gi gos gyon nas snod lag tu khyer te/ bsod snyoms la 'gro ba mdzes sam mi mdzes zhes steng gi sgo chung phye nas blta'o/ /sna tshogs pa'i 'dod chags dang bral ba yang dag par 'bar zhing sku lus kyi 'od kyis 8grong khyer gyi stong thams cad snang bar mdzad de/ 'dom gang ba'i 'od kun nas bskor pozhing rab tu gsal phonab dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu dang ldan pa skyes bu 31—684

chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis brgyan pa sangs rgyas kyi dpal dpe med par rnam par gsal ba mthong ngo / /gtsug tor nas bzung nas zhabs kyi ①mthil gyi bar de srid do/ /dbu skra g.yas 'khyil 'jam gnag7snum pa dang /dpral ba dri med nyi ma'i mthil bzhin no/ /sku dang 'tshamasapa'i shangs ni mtho ba dang / /mi yi seng ge 'od zer gsal bar mdzadadu/ /'di lta bu la sogasasnyipa'i mi'i seng ge la tshigs su bcad pas mngon par bstod do/ /khyed kyi sras po bsod snyoms la spyod do zhes rgyal po la smras so/ /rgyal po'i sems sdug bsngalamadubs gosalgenas bzung ste〈 )myur zhing myur bar phyir 'thon te〈nyebacom ldan 'das kyi drung du 'khod nas smras tsho pa ci btsun pa bdag cag ngo tsha bas ci'i don du bsod snyoms mdzad/ dge slong 'di rnams kyi bza' ba bdag gis ster bar mi shes bsams pa7yin nam ci lags/ rgyal po chen po'i rigs kyi spyod pa yin no/ /btsun pa bdag cag shākya'i rigs zhes bya ba'i rigs so/ /de la rgyal rigs gcig kyang bsod7snyoms byed pa'i ming tsam yang med do/ /rgyal po chen po'i rigs zhes bya ba ni khyod kyi rigs 'di yin no/ /bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po mi dgyes pulgem mdzad cig /slar yang bdag cag gi mar me mdzad dang kauṇ+ḍa rgya dang 'od srung7zhes bya ba 'di sangs rgyas kyi rigs yin no/ /'di rnams dang gzhan sangs rgyas stong phrag du mas kyang bsod snyoms spyod cing 'tsho bar mdzad la/ srang gi dbus su 'khod pa nyid do/ /bag med lhag mar byed pa med/ /chos la spyod cing legs par spyod/ /chos la spyad na bde ba 'byung7/ /'jig rten 'di dang phyi mar bde/ /chos kyi rkang pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di bstan cing bshad do/ /tshigs su bcad pa'i mthar rgyal pos rgyun 31—685

du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob bo/ /chos spyod pa ni legs par spyod/ /nyes par spyod pa mi bya zhing / /chos spyad pa yis bde ba 'byungatu/ /'jig rten 'di dang pha rol du'o/ /slar yang chos kyi rkang pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di thos nas lan cig ②phyir 'ong gi (ge'abras bu thob par gyur to/ /chos skyong ba'i skyes rabs thosalgenas phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob par gyurakhuto/ /'chi ba'i dus su gdugs dkar po'i 'og tu dpal gyi mal stan gyi steng du gzims pa nyid na dgra bcom pa thob par gyurapo)to/ /dgon par gnas nas dka'akhuthub spyod pa rgyal po la dgos pa med do/ /rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon du byas nas slar yang bcom ldan 'das kyi lhung bzed bzung stel/ 'khor dang bcas pa khang bzangs 7chen po'i steng du yispyan drangs nas gya rnam pa'i bza' ba dang bca' ba dzo/1rnams drangs so/ /gdugs tshod zin pa'i mthar sgra gcan 'dzin gyi ma ma gtogs pa'i btsun mo 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad 'ongs nas bcom ldan 'das la phyag byas so/ /gzhan yang des 'khor gyi mi rnams la 'phags pa'i bu la phyag gyis zhes pho brjod nas/ gal te kho mo la yon tan yod na 'phags pa'i bu rang nyid kyiphamaganas su 'byon no/ /byon pa nyid na de la phyag byed do zhes brjod nas ma 'ongs so/ /rgyal pos lhung bzed bzung nas bcom ldan 'das nyan thos mchog gnyis dang bcas pa rgyal po'i bu mo'i khang bzangs su tsogashegs te/ rgyal po'i bu mo rang nyid ji ltar mos pa'i phyag byed cing gzhan dang 'gal ba cicung zad kyang ma byed ces nas gdan bshams pa mchog gi gung la bzhugs so/ /de myur du 'ongs nas byin pa bzung ste/ zhabs kyi steng du mgo bo bzhag nas ji ltar 'dod pa'i phyag byas so/ /rgyal po dang rgyal po'i bu 31—686

mos bcom ldan 'das la dga' ba mang pos yon tan la sogs7pas yon tan dang ldan par brjod nas/ btsun pa bdag gi bu mos nyid kyis gos ngur smrig gyon pa thosakunas/ de nas bzung ste dengakhugi bar du gos ngur smrig gyonasnyino/ /nyid kyis gdugs tshod lan cigashegasol ba thos nas bu mos kyang bza' ba lan cig zos so/ /nyid kyis mal stan chen po spangs pa thos nas/ nyal khri chung ba la nyal lo/ /nyid kyis me tog gi phreng ba dang spos la sogs pa la sred pa med pa thos nas/ me tog gi phreng ba dang spos la sogasalgepa la chags pa med pa skyes so/ /rang gi nye du rnams bdag gis gso'o zhes 'phrin bskur nas/gnyen gcigashel yang bltarwaste ba mi 'dug go/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta bu'i yon tan dang ldan pa ni bdag gi bu mo yin no zhes gsol to/ /rgyal po chen po ya mtshan mi che'o/ /'di da lta khyed srung〈nyebar byed pa'i rgyal po'i bu mo ye shes yongs su ma smin pa rang gis bsrung ngo / /sngar bsrung ba med cing ri la sogs pa la 'gro ba na/ ye shes yongs su ma 8rdzogs pa mirang gis bsrungs so zhes gsungs nas/ mi'am ci zla ba'i skyes rabs gsungs te stan (snyelas bzhengs nas gshegs so/ /nyi ma gnyis pa la rgyal bu gzhon nu dga' bo rgyal por dbang bskur ba dang / khang pa gsar pa'i nang du zhugs te bkra shis pa'i bag ma blangs nas nye bar gnas so/ /de'i khyim du gshegs nas gzhon nu lhung bzed zung shig ces rab tu dbyung bar dgongs nas bkra shis brjod de/ gdan lamu tshobazhengs nas gshegs so/ /ljongs kyi dge ba'i bu mos 'gro ba mthong ngo / /'phags pa'i bu myur du shog ces brjod nas blta'o/ /des kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi7lhung bzed gzung〈nyebar ma nus nas gtsug lag khang nyid du gshegs 34—687

so/ /bcom ldan 'das de la 'dod pa med pa nyid kyisanyerab tu 'byung ba byed do/ /'di ltar bcom ldan 'das grong khyer ser skyar gshegs shing nyi ma gsum pa la dga' bo rab tu byung bar byas so/ /nyi ma bdun pa la sgra gcan 'dzin gyi mas gzhon nu rgyan gyis brgyan nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du btang ngo / /bu stong phrag nyi shu'i dge slong 'khor dang bcas pa 'di rnams ltos/ gser gyi kha dog can gyi tshangs pa'i gzugs kyi mdog can dge sbyong 'di gi⑧khyed kyi yab bo/ /'di la gter chen po yod cing de 'thon pa nas bzung ③nas gter mthong ba med do/ / song la nor ⑤slongs shig /bdag khyed kyi bu gzhon nu yin no/ /rgyal por dbang bskur ba thob nas 'khor los sgyurasnyib la dbang byed par 'gyur ro/ /bdag la nor gyi don du nor stsal du gsol/ yab kyi nor bu bdag yin no zhes gsol cig ces smras pa dang / gzhon nu bcom ldan 'das dang nye bar song ste/ yab kyi drung du dga' ba skyes so/ /sems spro bar gyur to/ /dge sbyong des7khyed kyi grib ma ni de'o zhes brjod nas/ gzhan yang rang gi rigs pas brjod7cing 'khod do/ /bcom ldan 'das gdugs tshod kyi mthar rjes su yi rang ba mdzad nas gdan las bzhengs7te gshegs so/ /gzhon nus bdag la dge slong nor stsal du gsol/ bdag la dge ①slong nor stsal du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyi0rjes su 'brangasalgenas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gzhon nu phyir log la nga'i rjes su ma 'gro zhes pa dang / rjes su 'brangasnyib rnams kyang bcom ldan 'das dang 'gro gas nas byon te ldog par ma nus nas/ gzhon nu bcom ldan 'das dang lhan cig kun dga' ra ba nyid du phyin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bsams pa/ 'di yab kyi nor 'dod 31—688

cing ①'jig rten pa'i nor ni 'tshe ba dang bcas pa yin/ da ni gzhon nu la byang chub snying po des thob pa'i 'phags pa'i nor rnam pa bdun byin na⑧'jig rten las 'das pa'i nor gyi bdag po byed par 'gyur bar dgongs nas/ tshe dang ldan pa shākhuri'i bu bos te/ de'i phyir na shā ri'i bu khyod kyis gzhon nu sgra gcan 'dzin rab tu phyung zhes brjod nas rab tu byung ba byas so/ /slar yang rgyal po gzhon nu'i sdug bsngal cher skyes te bsran par ma nus nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi gnas su phyin te/ btsun pa 'phags pa ma dang pha yis rjes su ma gnang ba'i bu rab tu 'byung bar byed pa ma legs so zhes dam pa bslangs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de la dam pa byin no/ /slar yang nyi ma gnyis pa la rgyal po'i gnas su gdugs tshod gsol nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /rgyal pos btsun 0pa nyid dka' ba spyod pa'i dus su lha cig ⑦bdag gi drung du nye bar 'ongs nas khyed kyi bu dus las 'das so zhes smras so/ /de'i tshig la yid ches pa med cing bdag gi sras byang chub ma thob bar du dus las 'da' bar mi byed do/ /de'i tshig ⑧bdag gis bkag go 6)zhes brjod do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ da lta ji ltar khyod yid ches par byed/ slararwa)rus pa mthong nas khyed kyi bu shi'o zhes zer ba la yid ches par ma byas so/ /'di'i don 'byung ba ni7chos skyong ba chen po'i skyesacharabs su bshad do/ /gtam gyi mthar rgyal pos phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la gnas so/ /de ltar bcom ldan 'das kyi yab 'bras bu gsum la so sor gnas nas dge slong gi dge 'dun 'khor du byas so/ /slar yang rgyal po'i khab tu gshegs nas7bsil ba'i tshal du bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis shing rta lnga brgya'i nor khyer nas rgyal 34—689

po'i khab tu rang nyid dga' ba'i grogs kyi khang par song ste/ des sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das byon no zhes pa thos nas shin tu snga bar lha'i mthus sgo phye ste/ston pa'i drung du nye bar song nas chos thos te rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob par gyur —1)to/ /nyi ma gnyis pa la sangs rgyas la sogs tshapa'i dge 'dun la sbyin 5pa chen po phul lo/ /mnyan la yod du gshegs pa'i phyir du ston pa'i drung du dam bca' blangs 5rinas bar gyi lam dpag tshad bzhi bcu rtsa lnga'i gnas su 'bum phrag re re'i nor byin nas dpag tshad re re'i gtsug lag khang byas so/ /rgyal byed tshal bye ba phrag bcwa 6brgyad kyi dbyig gis nyos nas las kha gsar pa byed cing dbus su stobs bcu pa'i dri'i 7gtsang khang byed do/ /de la bskor ba rnams la gnas brtan chen po brgyad cu'i bzhugs gnas so/ /tshig⑧thog dang nyis thog dang khang pa ring po dang / bsti gnas la sogs pa'i bzhugs gnas dang ske/ rdzing 1bu dang / 'chag sa dang / mtshan mo'i bzhugs gnas dang /nyin mo'i bzhugs gnas so/ /bye ba phrag bcwa 7brgyad kyi nor spel te yid du 'ong ba'i sa phyogs yid la 'thad pa'i gtsug lag khang byed do/ /stobs bcu pa byon nyu1pa'i phyir du pho nya ba btang ngo 12/ /ston pas pho nya ba'i 'phrin gsan nas dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po'i nyu 'khor du byas te rgyal po'i khab nas phyir byon te go rims —bzhin du grong khyer mnyan yod du byon no/ /gtso bo chen po ⑫gtsug lag khang chen po sta 7gon byas nas de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal byed tshal du〈 byon pa'i nyin mo bu rgyan sna thams cad kyis brgyan no/ /slar yang brgyan pa nyid kyi gzhon nu lnga brgya dang bcas pa btang ngo / /de 'khor dang bcas pa kha dog lnga'i gos yang dag par 'bar ba'i rgyal mtshan lnga brgya thogs nas stobs bcu 34wa 690

pa'i mdun du song bar gyur to/ /de rnams kyi phyi ma la legs bzangs ti chen mo dang ske/ legs bzangs nam chung ba ste ri bu mo gnyis gzhon nu ma lnga brgya dang bcas pa gser gyis gang ba'i bum pa lag par thogs nas phyir 'thon no/ /de'i phyi ma la tshong dpon gyi chung ma rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan nas bud med lnga brgya dang bcas pa gser gyis gang ba'i sder ma chen 4po thogs nas phyir 'thon to / /thams cad phyin nas tshong dpon rang nyid gos bzang po gyon no/ /de bzhin du gos bzang po gyon pa'i tshong dpon lnga brgya dang bcas pa bcom ldan 'das kyi nyedrung du song ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyi 'khor dge bsnyen 'di rnams mdun du byas nas/ dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po rnams 'khor du byas te / rang nyid kyi sku lus kyi 'od 6kyis gser gyi bcud kyi gong bu lta bu dang mtshungs pa dang / nags tshal gyi bar du snang bar mdzad cing mtha' yas pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rol pa sangs rgyas kyi dpal zla med cing mtshungs pa med pa rgyal byed tshal gyi nang du byon no/ /de nas mgon med zas sbyin 7gyis zhus pa/btsun pa gtsug rin lag khang 'di ji lta bu la dbul bar bgyi/ khyim bdag gtsug lag khang 'di 'ong ba dang 'gro ba'i dge slong gi dge 'dun rnams la phul cig /legs so bcom ldan 'das zhes tshong dpon chen pos gser gyi ril ba spyi blugs blangs ༄9tshonas stobs bcu pa'i phyag tu chu steng ste1 / rgyal byed tshal gyi gtsug lag khang 'di /1'gro ba dang 'ong 12ba'i phyogs bzhi'i sangs rgyas la sogs pa'i dge 'dun la sbyin zhes phul lo/ /ston pas gtsug lag khang bzhes 1lhanas rjes su yi rang ba mdzad do/ /grang dang dro bas mi nyams shing / /de ltar ri dgas la sogs pa'i/ /sdig sbrul dang ni sbrang bu dang / /ba mo dang ni char pas so/ /34—691

༄dzi /rgya gar skad du/ ā ṭā nā ṭi'uya sru tra/ bod skad du/ lcang lo can gyisapho brang gi mdo/ 'phags pa dkon mchog gsum la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab bya rgod phung po'i ri la bzhugs so/ /de nas rgyal po chen po bzhi po gnod sbyin mang po'i sde dang / dri za mang po'i sde dang grul bum gyi sde mang po dang klu'i sde mang po rnams phyogs bzhi bsrung zhing gnas so/ /phyogs bzhir tshanasnyitshan du gnas so/ /phyogs bzhi skyob cing gnas so/ /mtshan mo 'ongs te kha dog sna tshogs pa can gyis bya rgod phung po'i ri 'ba' zhig snang bar byas te/bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song shenas bcom ldan 'das la phyag byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /gnod sbyin de rnams las kyang gang la las bcom ldan 'das la phyag byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /gang su dag rtsigis 31—724

bcom ldan 'das la snyun chagasol te snyun〈gugasol nas ji ltar snying po dang snying po med pa'i gtam 'dri zhing phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /gang su dag gis bcom ldan 'das la thal mo sbyar ba'i phyag byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /gang su dag gis ming dang rigs dpyodapha0cing phyogs gcig9)tu 'khod do/ /gang su dag cang mi smra bar phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /phyogs gcig tu 'khod nas de nas rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyipo)bus/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /gnod sbyin ma rungs pa gang la la zhig bcom ldan 'das la ma dad par gyur to/ /gnod sbyin ma rungs pa gang la la zhig bcom ldan 'das la dad par gyur to/ /gnod sbyin 'bring po gang la la zhig btsun pa bcom ldan 'das la ma dad par gyur to/ /gnod sbyin 'bring po gang la la zhig btsun pa bcom ldan 'das la dad par gyur to/ /gnod sbyin dman pa gang la la zhig btsun pa bcom ldan 'das la ma dad par gyur7)to/ /gnod sbyin dman pa gang la la zhig btsun pa bcom ldan 'das la dad par gyur to/ /gnod sbyin gang la la zhig btsun pa bcom ldan 'das la rmum dad par gyur pa'i rgyu gang lags / btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis srog gcod pa spong ba'i chos bstan pa dang ske/ ma byin par len pa spong ba'i chos bstan pa dang / 'dod pa log par spyod pa spong ba'i0)chos bstan pa dang / brdzun du smra ba spong ba'i chos bstan pa dang ske/ myos ⑨par 'gyur ba'i chang gi tshibatung ba spong ba'i chos bstan 17pa mdzad la/ gnod sbyin gang de rnams srog gcod pa spong ba la mi dga' bar gyur pa dang / ma byin par hurtelen pa spong ba la mi dga' bar gyur pa dang /'dod pa log par spyod pa spong ba7rtel mi dga' bar gyur pa dang / brdzun du smra 34—725

ba spong ba la mi dga' bar gyur ①pa dang / myos ②par 'gyur ba'i chang gi ③btung ba spong ba la mi dga' bar gyur pas de rnams la mi dga' zhing mi 'dod par gyur to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis 0nyan thos ji snyed yod pa rnams 'brog dgon pa'i lam du zhugs nas nyal ba dang 'dug pa la brten do⑤/ /sgra med cing dbyangs med par dben par gnas shing 'du 'dzi'isnyi'atshe ba med do / /so sor dge sbyong rnams 'thun par gnas so/ /de na gnod sbyin ma rungs pa rnams kyi gnas yod do/ /gang zhig gis bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung rab la ma dad par gyur te/ de rnams dad par bya ba'i phyir btsun pa bcom ldan 'das la bslab par bya ste/ lcang lo can gyi pho brang gis bsrung du gsol/dge slong ngam dge slong ma 'am/ dge bsnyen 3)nam dge bsnyen ma rnams la bsrung ba dang / sba ba dang 'tshe ba med pa dang bde ba dang legs par gnas so / /bcom ldan 'das kyis cang mi gsung ba'i tshul gyis gnang ngo / /de nas rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bus bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang ba shes te/ de'i tshe 'di ltar lcang lo can gyi pho brang gis srungs7shig ces gsol to/ /spyan ldan dpal dang ldan pa yi/ /rnam par gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'byung po rnams la brtse ba yi/ /gtsug tor can la'ang phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon med rnams la gdung ba yi/ /thams cad skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdud kyi sde rnams 'joms pa yi/ /'khor ba 'jigashel phyag 'tshal lo/ /bram ze dpal dang ldan pa yi'i/ /gser thub la ni phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can rnam grol mdzad pa yi/ /'od srung /spel ni phyag 'tshal lo/ /shākya'i sras ni dpal dang ldan / /nyi ma'i rgyud la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sdug bsngal kun las sgrol mdzad pa/ /34—726

gang zhig chos ni rab ston mdzad/ /gang yang 'jig rten par gyur7)pa/ /ji lta ba bzhin gzigs gyur pa'i/ /de rnams la ni phra ma med/ /'jigs pa med pa chen po'o/ /gang zhig go tam phyag byed pa/ /lha dang mi la phan pa yin na)/ /rig pa dang ni zhabs su ldan/ /'jigs pa med pa chen po ste/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor chen po ni/ / gang zhig tu ni nub cing 'char/ /tshigang du nyi ma nub gyur pa/ /de ni mtshan mor 'gyur ba yin/ /gang du nyi ma shar gyur pa/ /de ni nyin mo zhes brjod do/ /gting ni zab pa'i rgya mtsho yi/ /de yimathu/chu yi bcud bzang ngo / /de ltar der ni skyes gyur pasnyi/ /rgya mtsho'i chu yi bcud bzhin no/ /'dir7ni shar gyi phyogs kyi ni/ /skye bam̐ rnams la 'di brjod de/ /de yi phyogs ni kun skyong ba'i/ /rgyal po chen po grags chen ldan/ /dri za rnams kyi bdag po ste/ /ming ni rgyal po yul 'khor skyong / /dri za 'khor dang bcas pa ni/ /glu dang gar gyis dga' bar byed/ /de yi bu ni mang po rnams/ /ming ni gcig tu thos pa ste/ /dbang po zhes bya stobs dang ldan/ /de ni dgu bcu rtsa gcig go//de yang sangs rgyas mthong ba dang / /nyi ma'i gnyen gyi sangs rgyas ni/ /'jigs dang bral ba chen po la/ /thag ring nas ni phyag bgyi'o/ /skyes bu cang mkhyen khyed phyag 'tshal/ /skyes bu mchog khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge ba rtag tu gsung ba la/ /mi ma yin rnams khyod phyag 'tshal/ /rtag tu 'di ni nyan pa'o/ /de phyir de ltar 'di brjod de/ /rgyal ba go tam phyag gyis shig /rgyal ba gau tam phyag bgyid do/ /rig ⑤pa dang ni zhabs su ldan/ /sangs rgyas gi tam phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang yang yi dgas rjodas9)byed pa/ /phra ma rgyab kyi sha can dang / /srog gcod pa la chags pa dang / /skye bo ma lus 'joms pa'o/ /'dir ni lho 31—727

yi phyogs gnas pa'i/ /skye bo rnams la 'di skad brjod①/ /de yi gnas ni yongs skyong ba/ /rgyal po chen po grags ldan pa/ /grul bum rnams kyi bdag po ste / /ming ni 'phags skyes po zhes bya/ /grul bum 'khor dang bcas pa ni/ /glu dang gar gyis dga' bar byed/ /de yi bu ni mang du po rnams/ /ming ni gcig tu thos pa ste(1/ /dbang po zhes bya stobs dang ldan/ /de ni dgu bcu rtsa gcig go/ /de yang sangs rgyas mthong ba dang / /nyi ma'i rgyud kyi /sangs rgyas ni / /'jigs dang bral ba chen po la/ /thag ring nas ni phyag bgyi'o/ /skyes bu cang mkhyen khyed phyag 'tshal/ /skyes bu mchog khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge ba rtag tu gsung 5)ba la/ /mi ma yin rnams khyed phyag 'tshal/ /rtag tu 'di ni nyan pa'o/ /de phyir de ltar 'di brjod rmosade/ /rgyal ba gi tam phyag gyis shig /rgyal ba gi tam phyag bgyid do/ /rig pa dang ni zhabs su ldan/ /sangs rgyas gi tam phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor chen po ni/ /gang nas gang du shar gyur pa/ /der ni nyin mor 'gyur ba ste/ /nyin mo zhes ni brjod pa yin/ /gang du nyi ma nub gyur pa/ /de ni mtshan mor rjod rtsodapar byed/ /gting ni zab pa'i rgya mtsho yi/ /de yi chu ni bcud bzang ngo / /de ltar der ni skyes gyur pa'i//rgya mtsho'i chu yi bcud bzhin no/ /'dir ni nub kyi phyogs kyi ni/ /skye bo rnams la 'di brjod de/ /de yi phyogs ni kun skyong ba'i/ /rgyal po chen po grags chen ldan / /klu rnams kyi ni bdag po ste/ /'di yi ming ni mig mi bzang / /klu yi 'khor dang bcas pa ni/ /glu dang gar gyis dga' bar byed/ /de yi bu ni mang po rnams/ /ming ni gcig tu thos pa ste/ /dbang po zhes bya stobs dang ldan/ /de ni dgu bcu rtsa gcig go/ /de yang sangs rgyas mthong ba dang / /nyi ma'i 34—728

gnyen7gyi sangs rgyas ni/ /'jigs dang bral ba chen po la/ /thag ring nas ni phyag bgyi'o/ /skyes bu cang mkhyen khyed phyag 'tshal/ /skyes bu mchog khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge ba rtag tu gsung ba la/ /mi ma yin rnams khyed phyag 'tshal / /rtag tu 'di ni nyan pa'o/ /de phyir de ltar 'di brjodam(2)de/ /rgyal ba gi tam phyag gyis shig /rgyal ba go tam phyag bgyid do/ /rig pa dang ni zhabs su ldan/ /sangs rgyas gi tam phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig byang phyogs sgra mi snyan/ /lhun po blta na sdug ri dga'/ /der skyes pa yi mi rnams ni/ /bdag gir7yongs su bzung ba med/ /de rnams sa bon 'debs pa med/ /rmo ba yang ni med pa yin/ /dka' spyad med par 'bras smin zhing / /mi rnams yongs su longs spyod do/ /spun med ma grugs shin tu dag /dri bzang 'bras ni 'bras burasaldan/ /'bras kyi 'o ma la 'tshed cing / /de bzhin btsos nas longs spyod do/ /ba lang rkang gcig la zhon nas/ /yul dang phyogs su 'gro bar byed/ /rkang pa gcigatshanapa'i phyugs zhi zhon nas/ /yul dang phyogs su 'gro bar byed/ /bud med kyi ni bzhon pa la/ /zhon nas yul dang phyogs su 'gro/ /skyes pa'i bzhon ④pa la zhon nas/ /yul dang phyogs su 'gro bar byed/ /gzhon nusam yi bzhon pa la/ /zhon nas yul dang phyogs su 'gro/ /gzhon nu'i bzhon pa la zhon nas/ /yul dang phyogs su 'gro bar byed/ /bzhon 3 pa de rnams la zhon nas/ /phyogs kun du ni rjes su 'gro/ /gtso bo rgyal po khyad med do/ /glang chen bzhon dang rta yi bzhon/ /lha yi bzhon 11pa la gnas nas//khang bzangs 3)dang ni khyogs lhanadang ni/ /rgyal po chen po gragasabodang ldan/ /de'i yang grub pa'i grong khyer ni/ /dri med bar snang la gnas pa/ /lcang lo can 31—729

dang ku sha'i71grong / /pha rol kukusha'i grong dang ni/ /nā ṭā'i⑧grong dang pha rol gyi/ /ku shi ta yitsha dgrong yin no/ /byang gi phyogs nasathams cad rgyas/ /skye47bo'i tshogs pa mang po gnas/ /dgu bcu rtsa dgu grong57mkha' la/ /rgyal po'i pho brang lcang lo can/ /slar yang drang srong chen po dang / /rgyal po chen po lus ngan po/ /bi sā ṇa zhes pa rgyal po'i pho brang ngo / /de'i phyir rgyal po chen po rnam nyethos kyi bu dang / lus ngan po zhes brjod do/ /so sor rab tu gsal zhing zhi ba dang de dang der ni de dang de mdangs dang de'i gzi brjid dang dpa' zhing stobs dang ldan pa'i rgyal po stobs dang ldan pa'i ming ngo / /sa gzhi yang ni bcud ldan no/ /gnas der sprin rnams char 'bebs par byed do/ /der ni bha ga la ba khrim zhes pa'i rdzing bu'o/ /gang du gnod 17sbyin tshogs dang lhan7cig tu gnas so/ /der ni rtag tu shing gi 'bras/ /sna tshogs bya rnams lhan cig gnas / /rma bya khrung khrung sgra sgrogs shing / /khu byug rnams ni tshan tshan gnas/ /shang shang te'u sgra sgrogs shing / /de nas yang ni nguras /3pa dang / /gong mo nags kyi bya gag k+ṣani/ /nags kyi rdzing bur gnas pa'o/ /ne tsho7ri skegs de sgra 'byin/ / daṇa ṭa mā ṭa79bya dkar ni/ /dus kun du ni mdzes par byed/ /lus ngan rgyal po'i rdzing rtag mdzes/ /'di ni byang gi phyogs kyi yul/ /skye ⑩bo rnams ni 'di bzhin brjod/ /de yi phyogs ni yongs nyunyeskyong ba'i/ /rgyal po chen po grags dang ldan/ /gnod sbyin rnams kyi bdag po ste/ /'di yi ming ni lus ngan po/ /gnod sbyin 'khor dang bcas pa ni/ /glu dang gar gyis dga' bar byedarka/ /de yi bu ni mang po rnams/ /ming ni gcig tu thos pa ste/ /dbang po zhes bya stobs dang ldan/ /de ni dgu bcu rtsa gcig go/ /de yang sangs rgyas 31—730

mthong ba dang / /nyi ma'i gnyen gyi sangs rgyas ni6)/ /'jigs dang bral ba chen po 'kho/ /thag ring nas ni phyag bgyi'o/ /skyes bu cang mkhyen khyed phyag 'tshal / /skyes bu mchog khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge ba rtag tu gsungs ba la/ /mi ma yin rnams khyed phyag 'tshal/ /rtag tu 'di ni nyan pa'o/ /de phyir de ltar 'di0brjod de/ /rgyal ba gi tam phyag gyis shig /rgyal ba sga tam phyag bgyid do/ /rig pa dang ni zhabs su ldan/ /sangs rgyas gi tam phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir ni drang srong chen pos lcang lo can gyi pho brang dang bcas pas srungs 3)shig / dge slong ngam khyadage slong ma 'am dge bsnyen nam 9)dge bsnyen (nyam rnams la bsrung7ba dang / sba ba dang / 'tshe ba med pa dang / bde ba dang legs par gnas so/ /drang srong chen po gang 3su dag dge slong dang bcas pa 'am dge slong ma dang bcas pa 'am dge bsnyen tsha/medang bcas pa 'am dge bsnyen /nyam dang bcas pa rnams la/ 'dir lcang lo can gyi pho brang gis de bsrung ba dang yongs su rdzogs pa thams cad yid la zung shig1ge /de'i yang mi ma yin rnams so/ /gnod sbyin nam gnod sbyin mo'am gnod sbyin gyi bu pho 'am/ gnod sbyin gyi bu mo 'am gnod sbyin gyi blon po chen po 'am gnod sbyin gyi 'khor ram gnod sbyin gyi g.yog 'khor ram/ dri za pho 'am dri za mo 'am dri za'i bu pho 'am 8dri za'i bu mo 'am dri za'i blon po chen po 'am dri za'i 'khor ram dri za'i g.yog 'khor ram/ grul bum pho 'am grul bum mo 'am grul bum gyi bu pho 'am grul bum gyi bu mo 'am grul bum gyi blon po chen po 'am grul bum gyi 'khor ram grul bum gyi g.yog 'khor ram/ klu pho 'am klu mo 'am klu'i bu pho 'am klu'i bu mo 'am klu'i blon po chen po ⑩'am klu'i 'khor ram klu'i g.yog 'khor ram/ rab tu snang ba'i 31—731

sems kyis 'gro711'am rjes su 'gro 'am rjes su 'gro ba dang sdod pa dang lhan cig tu sdod pa dang / gnas pa dang lhan cig tu gnas pa dang / nyal ba dang lhan cig tu nyal ba rnams ni drang srong chen po 'di rnams ni mi ②ma yin zhes bya'o/ /grong ngam grong rdal na lam bkur stimapa byed pa'am bsti55)stang du byed pa la drang srong chen po mi ma yin rnams kyis de thob pa ma yin no/ /rgyal po'i pho brang lcang lo can zhes bya ba la gzhi'am gnasal461med do/ /drang srong chen po mi ma yin rnams dang gnod sbyin rnams kyis lhan cig tu gnas pa'ang mi 'thob(3)bo/ /drang srong chen po gzhan yang mi cho8)ma yin rnams kyitshamatshobaka' mnyan par bya'o/ /drang srong chen po gzhan yang mi ma yin rnams kyis bdag la phan pa rdzogs pa dang / pha rol la smod pa dang rtsod 0pa dang / drang srong chen po gzhan yang mi ma yin rnams la snod /1mer rab tu 'bar ba mgo la bkon 12pa dang / drang srong chen po gzhan yang mi ma yin rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa bdun du gshegatshwanyepar byed do/ /drang srong chen po gzhan yang mi ma yin ni gtum pa dang drag pa dang khro ba'o/ /de rnams kyis 'di ltar rgyal po chen po la rjod /jipar byed do/ /rgyal po chen poshel brjod tshepar ma nus na skyes bu la sogs nyu snapa la rjod /2par byed do/ /rgyal po'i skyes bu la brjod 19par ma nus na de'i 'og ma'i skyes bu rnams la rjod5) par byed do/ /drang srong chen po de yang mi ma yin rnams rgyal po chen po la 'gal ba smra ba'o/ /drang srong chen po 'di lta ste/ ma ga d+ma'i (1/yul gyi rgyal po la chom rkun byung na de ma thag tu rgyal po la rjod sa par byed do/ /rgyal po la brjod par ma nus na rgyal po'i skyes bu la rjod ri snyepar byed do/ /skyes bu la brjod par ma nus na de'i 'og ma'i skyes bu la rjod 39par byed pa bzhin no/ /drang srong chen 34wa 732

po de yang ma ga ṅgā'i hu)rgyal po la chom rkun tshon/gyis gnod pa byed par brjodamu do/ /drang srong chen po〈pe'adi lta bu mi52ma yin yod pa rnams gtum pa dang drag pa dang khro ba'o/ /de ma thag tu rgyal po chen po'i rnams la rjodasho par byed do/ /rgyal po chen po la brjod par ma nus na rgyal po'i skyes bu la rjod na par byed do/ /skyes bu la brjod par ma nus na de'i spu 'og ma'i skyes bu la rjod nyi ripar byed do/ /drang srong chen po de ni mi ma yin rnams rgyal po chen po rnams la 'gal bar rjod71par byed5nyedo/ /drang srong chen po mi ma yin gang zhig gnod sbyin pho 'am gnod sbyin mo 'am gnod sbyin gyi bu 'am 32gnod sbyin gyi bu mo 'am gnod sbyin gyi blon po chen po 'am gnod sbyin gyi 8'khor ram gnod sbyin gyi g.yog 'khor ram/ dri za pho'am dri za mo 'am dri za'i bu pho 'am dri za'i bu mo 'am dri za'i blon po chen po 'am dri za'i 'khor ram 7dri za'i g.yog 'khor ram/ grul bum pho 'am grul bum mo 'am grul bum gyi bu pho 'am grul bum gyi bu mo 'am grul bum gyi blon po chen po 'am grul bum gyi 'khor ram grul bum gyi g.yog 'khor ram/ klu pho 'am klu mo 'am klu'i bu pho 'am klu'i bu mo 'am klu'i blon po chen po tshe'am klu'i 'khor ram klu'i g.yog 'khor 1 tshoram/ rab tu sdang ba'i sems kyis dge slong ngam dge slong ma 'am dge bsnyen nam dge bsnyen 18ma rnams 'gro ba'am rjes su 'gro ba'ams/rtorjes su 'gro ba dang sdod pa dang lhan cig tu sdod pa dang / di gnas pa dang lhan cig51tu gnas pa dang / nyal ba dang lhan cig tu nyal ba dang / 'di rnams ni gnod sbyin rnams dang / gnod sbyin chen po rnams dang / sde dpon rnams dang ske/ sde dpon chen po rnams la gsol bar byed pa dang / nga ro sgrogs par byed pa dang / sgra cher sgrogs par byed pa'o/ /'dir gnod sbyin gyis bzungs rte34wa 733

nas gnod sbyin 'dis 1)tshe 'phrog par byed pa dang / gnod sbyin 'dis 'tshe bar byed pa dang / gnod sbyin 'dis rnam par tho 'tshamadza napar byed pa dang /gnod sbyin 'dis bganod par byed pa dang / gnod sbyin 'dis ④rnam par gnod par byed pa dang / gnod sbyin 'dis ni mi gtong bar byed do/ /gnod sbyin rnams dang gnod sbyinasachen po rnams dang / sde dpon rnams dang sde dpon chen pone'u)rnams gang zhe na/ dbang po zla ba chu7zla dang / /bhā ra dwa dza skye dgu'i bdag /tsan da na dngasnye'od mchog dang / /mgul pa mdzes dang mgul nges dang / /skye dgu'i bla mar gyur pa dang / /lha las byung ba'i kha lo pa//dri za sna tshogs sde dang ni/ /mi rgyal rgyal ba'i khyu mchog dang / /de bzhin ri dang gangs can dang / /gang ba smin drug phug dang ni/ /'tsho ba dang ni btang bzunga'akhedang / /sna tshogs bshes gnyen gnya' shing 'dzin/ /sa skyong rab tu rtogs pa dang / /ngo tsha mig dang khang pa dang / /lnga len gtum po āl ba ka /srid sgrub yid bzang bzhin bzang dang / /zho gdong nor bu nor bu spyod/ /de bzhin dbang phyug dang bcas so/ /'di rnams ni gnod sbyin rnams dang /gnod sbyin chen po rnams dang / sde dpon rnams dang sde dpon chen po rnams la gsol bar byed pa dang / nga ro sgrogs par byed pa dang / sgra cher sgrogs par byed pa'o/ /'dir gnod sbyin gyis bzung nas gnod sbyin 'dis tshe 'phrog par byed pa dang / gnod sbyin 'dis 31'tshe bar byed pa dang / gnod sbyin 'dis rnam par tho 'tsham nyugepar byed pa dang / gnod sbyin 'disalgeganod par byed pa dang / gnod sbyin 'disalgenam par gnod par byed pa dang / gnod sbyin 'dis ni mi gtong bar byed do/ /drang srong chen po 'dis ni lcang lo can gyi 31—734

pho brang gis srungs shig① /dge slong dang dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang dge bsnyen ma rnams la bsrung ba dang / sba ba dang / 'tshe ba med pa dang /bde ba dang / legs par gnas so/ /drang srong chen po de ni bdag cag rnams 'gro bar bgyi'o/ /bdag cag rnams ni bya ba mang ba dang byed pa mang bas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po khyed rnams dasheni 'gro bar gyis shig /de nas rgyal po chen posebazhi po rnams langs nas/bcom ldan 'das la phyag byas te bskor ba byas nas der mi snang bar gyur to/ /gnod sbyin de rnams kyang langs nas gang su dag gis bcom ldan 'das la phyag byas te bskor ba byas nas de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /gang su dag gis bcom ldan 'das la snyun gsol te snyan⑧gsol nas snying po dang snying po med pa ji ltar zhes zhus pa de rnams de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /gang su dag gis bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der thal mo sbyar nas de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /gang la la zhig gis ming dang rigs rnam par dpyad nas de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /gang la la zhig cang mi smra bar gyur te de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /lcang lo can gyi pho brang gi mdo las skabs rab mchog dang po'o// /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i mtshan mo 'das nas dge slong rnams bos nas dge slong dag 'di'i mtshan mo rgyal po chen po bzhi po rnams dang /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po rnams dang dri za'i sde mang po dang / grul bum gyi sde mang po dang / klu'i sde mang po dang / phyogs bzhi bsrung zhing gnas so/ /phyogs bzhir tshan tshan du gnas so/ /phyogs bzhi skyong zhing gnas so/ /31—735

mtshan mo 'ongs te kha dog sna tshogs pa can gyis bya rgod phung po'i ri 'ba' zhig snangs1)bar byas te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste50song nas nga la phyag byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /dge slong dag dang gnod sbyin de rnams gang la la zhig gis nga la phyag byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /gang su dag gis nga la snyan gsol te snyun ①gsol nas ji ltar snying po dang snying po med pa'i gtam 'dri zhing phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /gang su dag gis nga la thal mo sbyar nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /gang su dag gis ming dang rigs dpyod cing phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /gang su dag cang mi smra bar phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /phyogs gcig tu 'khodarnyunas dge slong dag dang rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bus nga la 'di skad ces gsol nas/ gnod sbyin ma rungs pa yod pa rnams ltebatsun pa bcom ldan 'das la ⑥ma dad par gyur to④/ /gnod sbyin ma rungs pa07gang la la zhig bcom ldan 'dasaphul dad par gyur to//gnod sbyin 'bring po gang la la zhig btsun pa bcom ldan 'das la ma dad par gyur sna rito/ /gnod sbyin 'bring po gang la la zhig btsun pa bcom ldan 'das lamadzo/dad par gyur to/ /gnod sbyin dman pa gang la la zhig btsun pa bcom ldan 'das la ma dad par gyur to/ /gnod sbyin dman pa gang la la zhig btsun pa bcom ldan 'das la dad par gyur to/ /gnod sbyin gang la la zhig btsun pa bcom ldan 'das la ma dad par gyur pa'i rgyu gang lags/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis srog gcod pa spong ba'i chos bstan pa dang / ma byin par len pa spong ba'i chos bstan /2pa dang / 'dod pasarwarnyelog par spyod pa spong ba'i chos bstan pa dang / brdzun du smra ba spong ba'i chos bstan pa dang / myos par 31—736

'gyur ba'i chang gi btung ba spong ba'i chos bstan pas so/ /gnod sbyin gang517de rnams btsun pas srog gcod pa spong ba la mi dga' bar gyur pa dang / ma byin par len pa spong ba la mi dga' bar gyur rinapa dang / 'dod pas (7log par spyod pa spong ba la mi dga' bar gyur pa dang / brdzun du smra ba spong ba la mi dga' bar gyur pa dang / myos par 'gyur ba'i chang gi btung ba spong ba la mi dga' bar gyur pas so/ /de rnams la mi dga' zhing mi 'dod par gyur to/ /btsunasnyipa bcom ldan 'das nyan thos ji snyed yod pa rnams 'brog dgon pa'i lam du zhugs nas nyal ba dang 'dug pa dang brten to/ /sgra med cing dbyangs med par dben par gnas shing 'du 'dzi'i 'tshe ba med do/ /so sor dge sbyong rnams 'thun ⑤zhing gnas so/ /de na gnod sbyin ma rungs pa (67rnams kyi sh-iganas yod do/ /gang zhig bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung (8)rab la ma dad par gyur te/ de rnams dad par bya ba'i phyir btsun pa bcom ldan 'das la bslab par bya ste/ lcang lo can gyi pho brang gis bsrung du gsol/ dge slong ngam dge slong ma 'am/ dge bsnyen nam dge bsnyen ma rnams la bsrung ba dang / sba ba dang ske/ 'tshe ba med pa dang / bde ba dang legs par gnas so/ /dge slong rnams la bdag gis cang mi gsung ba'i tshul gyis gnang ba byin no/ /de nas rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bus gnang ba byin pa 9shes te/ de'i tshe 'di ltar lcang lo can gyi pho brang gis srungs shig ces gsol to/ /spyan ldan dpal dang ldan pa yi/ /rnam par gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can rnams la brtse ba yi/ /gtsug tor can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon med rnams la gdung ba yi//thams cad skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdud kyi sde rnams 'joms pa yi /34—737

'khor ba 'jigate①la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bram ze dpal dang ldan pa yi/ /gser thub la yang〈phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can rnam grol mdzad pa yi/ /'od srung la ni phyag 'tshal lo/ /shākya'i sras ni dpal dang ldan/ /nyi ma'i rgyud la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sdug bsngal kun las grol mdzad pa'i / /gang zhig chos ni rab ston⑧mdzad/ /gang yang 'jig rten par gyur pa/ /ji lta ba bzhin gzigs gyur pa'i/ /de rnams la ni phra ma med/ /'jigs pa med pa chen po ni/ /gang zhig gi tam phyag byed pa/ /lha dang mi la phan pa7yin/ /rig pa dang ni zhabs su ldan/ /'jigasalgepa med pa chen po ste/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor chen po ni/ /gang zhig tu ni57nub cing 'char/ /gang du nyi ma nub gyur pa/ /der ni mtshan mor 'gyur ba yin/ /gang du nyi ma shar gyur pa/dun/ /der ni nyin mo zhes brjod do / /gting ni zab pa'i rgya mtsho yi/ /de yi chu yi bcud bzang ngoshe/ /de ltar der ni skyes gyur pa'i/ /rgya mtsho'i d+me yi bcud bzhin no/ /'dir ni shar gyi phyogs kyi ni/ /skye bo rnams la 'di brjod do/ /de yi phyogs ni yongs skyong ba'i / /rgyal po chen po grags7chen ldan/ /dri za rnams kyi bdag po ste/ /ming ni rgyal po yul 'khor skyong / /dri za 'khor dang bcas pa ni/ /glu dang gar gyis dga' bar byed/ /de yi bu ni mang po rnams/ /ming ni gcig tu thos pa ste/ /dbang po zhes bya stobs dang ldan/ /de ni dgu bcu rtsa gcig go/ /de yang sangs rgyas mthong ba dang / /nyi ma'i gnyen gyi sangs rgyas ni/ /'jigs dang bral ba chen po la/ /thag ring nas ni phyag bgyi'o/ /skyes bu cang mkhyen khyed phyag 'tshal/ /skyes bu mchog khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge ba rtag tu gsung〈nyeb la/ /mi ma yin rnams khyed7phyag 'tshal/ /rtag tu 'di ni nyan pa'o/ /de 34wa 738

phyir de ltar 'di brjod do/ /rgyal ba go tam phyag gyis shig /rgyal ba go7)tam phyag bgyid do / /rig pa dang ni zhabs su ldan/ /rgyal ba go tam phyag 'tshal lo / /gang yang yi dgas5)rjod byed pa/ /phra ma rgyab kyi sha can dang / /srog gcod pa la chags pa dang / / skye bosnyim lus 'joms pa'o/ /'dir ni lho yi phyogs gnas pa'i/ /skye bo rnams la 'di skad brjod/ /de yi gnas ni yongs skyong ba/ /rgyal po chen po grags ldan pa/ /grul bum rnams kyi bdag po ste/ /ming ni 'phags skyes po zhes bya/ /grul bum 'khor dang bcas pa ni/ /glu dang gar gyis dga' bar byed/ /de yi bu ni mang po rnams/ /ming ni gcig tu thos pa ste/ /dbang po zhes bya stobs dang ldan/ /de ni dgu bcu rtsa gcig go/ /de yang sangs rgyas mthong ba dang / /nyi ma'i rgyud kyi sangs rgyas ni/ /'jigs dang bral ba chen po la/ /thag ring nas ni 5/phyag bgyi'o/ /skyes bu cang mkhyen khyed phyag 'tshal/ /skyes bu mchog khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge ba rtag tu gsung ba la/ /mi ma yin〈rnams khyed phyag 'tshal/ /rtag tu 'di ni nyan pa'o/ /de phyir de ltar 'di brjod de/ / rgyal ba gau tam phyag gyis shig ༷rgyal ba goshetam phyag bgyid7)do/ /rig77pa dang ni zhabs su ldan/ /sangs rgyas go72tam phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor chen po ni/ /gang nas gang du shar gyur pa / /der ni nyin mor 'gyur ba ste/ /nyin mo nyi zhes ni brjod pa yin/ /gang du nyi ma nub gyur pa/ /der7ni mtshan mor rjodamatshapar byed/ /gting ni zab pa'i rgya mtsho yi/ / de yi 1 tshochu yi bcud bzang ngo / /de ltar der ni skyes gyur pa'i / /rgya mtsho'i churwa yi bcud bzhin no/ /'dir ni nub kyi phyogs kyi ni/ /skye bo rnams la 'di brjod de/ /de yi phyogs ni kun skyong ba'i / /rgyal po chen 31—739

po grags chen ldan/ /klu rnams kyi ni bdag po ste/ /'di yi ming ni mig mi bzang ske/ /klu yi 'khor dang bcas pa ni/ /glu dang gar gyis dga' bar byed/ /de yi bu ni mang po rnams/ /ming ni gcig tu thos pa ste/ /dbang po zhes bya stobs dang ldan/ /de ni dgu bcu rtsa gcig go/ / de yang0nyesangs rgyas mthong ba dang / /nyi ma'i gnyen gyi sangs rgyas ni/ /'jigs dang bral bshechen po la//thag ring nas ni phyag bgyid do/ /skyes bu cang mkhyen khyed phyag 'tshal/ /skyes bu mchog khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge ba rtag tu gsung〈 )ba la mi ma yin rnams khyed phyag 'tshal/ /rtag tu 'di ni nyan pa'o/ /de phyir de ltar 'di brjod do/ /rgyal ba gi btam phyag gyis shig /rgyal ba gi5getam phyag bgyid do/ /rigasapa dang ni zhabs su ldan/ /sangs rgyas gi9)tam phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig byang phyogs sgra mi snyan/ /lhun po blta ⑧na sdug ri dga'(pe/ /der skyes pa yi mi rnams ni/ /bdag gir yongs su bzung ba med/ /de rnams sa bon 'debs pa med/ /rmo ba yang nis med pa yin/ /dka' spyad med par 'bras smin nas/ /mi rnams yongs su longs spyod de(1/ /sbun med ma grugs shin tumanyedag /dri bzang 'bras ni 'bras bur ldan/ /'bras kyi 'o ma la 'tshed cing / /de bzhin btsos nyurtenas longs spyod do/ /ba lang rkang gcig la zhon nas/ /yul dang phyogs su 'gro bar byed/ /rkang pa gcig pa'i phyugs zhon nas/ /yul dang phyogs su 'gro bar byed/ /bud med kyi ni bzhon pa la/ /zhon nas yul dang phyogs su 'gro/ /skyes pa'i bzhon pa la zhon nas/ /yul dang phyogs su 'gro bar byed/ /gzhon nu ma yi bzhon pa la/ /zhon nas yul dang phyogs su 'gro / /gzhon nu'i bzhon pa la zhon nas/ /yul dang phyogs su 'gro bar byed/ /34—740

bzhon pa de rnams la zhon nas/ /phyogs kun du ni rjes su 'gro/ /gtso bo rgyal po khyad med do/ /glang chen bzhon dang rta yi bzhin/ / lha yi7)bzhon pa la gnas nas/ /khang bzangasakhudang ni khyogs rnams ni/ /rgyal po chen po grags chen ldan/ /de'i yang grub pa'i grong khyer ni/ /dri med bar snang la gnas pa/ /lcang lo can dang kuphusha'i grong / /pha rol ku7sha'i grong dang ni/ /nā ṭā'i grong dang pha rol gyi/ /ku shi ta yi gegrong yin no/ /byang gi phyogs na thams cad rgyas / /skye bo'i tshogs pa mang po gnas/ /dgu bcu rtsa dgu grong mkha' la/ /rgyal po'i pho brang lcang7lo can/ /slar yang drang srong chen po dang / /rgyal po chen po lus ngan po/ /cog ldan zhes pa rgyal po chen po'i pho brang ngo / /de'i phyir rgyal po chen po0)rnam thos kyi bu dang lus ngan po zhes brjod do/ /so sor rab tu gsal zhing zhi ba dang de dang der ni de dang de mdangs dang de'i gzi brjid dang dpa' zhing stobs dang ldan pa'i khyargyal po stobs dang ldan pa'i ming ngo —/ /sa gzhi yang ni bcud ldan no/ /gnas der sprin rnams char 'bebs par byed do/ /der ni bha ga la ba tī lha )zhes pa'i rdzing bu'o/ /gang du gnod sbyin tshogs dang lhan cig tu gnas so/ /der ni rtag tu shing gi 'bras/ /sna tshogs bya rnams lhan cig gnas/ /rma bya khrungarmāḥkhrung sgra sgrogs shing / /khu byug rnams ni tshan tshan gnasanyurte/ /shang shang te'u sgra sgrogs shing / /de nas yang ni ngur pa dang / /gong mo nags 32kyi bya gag rnams/ /nags kyi rdzing bur gnas pa'o / /ne tso ri skegs0de sgra 'byin/ / daṇa ṭa thornyimā na bya dkar dang / /dus kun du ni mdzes par byed/ /lus ngan rgyal po'i rdzing rtag mdzes/ /'di ni byang gi phyogs kyi yul/ / skye botsornams ni 'di bzhin brjod/ /de yi phyogs 34—741

dag 'jig rten gyi khams bcu'i lha rnams 'dus te de bzhin gshegs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pa blta ba'i phyir ro/ /dge slongashegang de rnams su gyur ②pa 'das pa'i dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de rnams bcom ldan 'das de tsam du gyur pa de bzhin du lha rnams 'dus par gyur to / zha'adi lta ste/ bdag kyang 'di skad ces smra stekhya/ dge slong dag lha'i tshogs rnams kyi ming brjod par bya ste/ dge slong dag rab tu gsal bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i lha'i tshogs dang / dge slong dag lha'i tshogs ston par byed pa zhes bya ba'o0/ /de thos nas legs par yid la zung7shig dang ngas bshad par bya'o/ /de ltar btsun pa bcom ldan 'das la dge slong de rnams kyis so sor zhus nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /tshigs su bcad pa so sor bshad/ /gang du sa gzhi7mthong gyur na⑨/ /ri yi phug tu gang gnas pa0/ /de ru mnyam par 'jog par byed/ /sa gzhir〈nyeseng ge 'jigs med bzhin/ /ba spu tsam yang g.yo ba med/ /sems ni dag cing dkar ba dang / /chu ni rab tu dngas bzhin du(nye/ /lnga brgya po yis legs shes shing ske/ /ser5)skya'i tshal gyisnyiganas mang po'/ /de nas dge slong ston pas bosatso / /bstan la dga' ba'i〈nyenyan thos rnams/ /lha yi tshogs rnams 'ongs nas ni/ /dge slong rnams kyis de shes bya/ /lus ni gdung〈kyebar ma byed par//sangs rgyas bstan pa thos pas so/ /de rnams ye shes snang bar 'gyur/ /mi ma yin rnams mthong 'gyur〈nyeb/ /gang zhig gis ni brgya mthong zhing / /stong dang bdun cu mthong ba yin/ /brgya dang stong phrag gcig spedang ni/ /mi ma yin rnams mthong bar 'gyur/ /gang zhig gis ni mtha' med mthong / /phyogs kun 34—755

gang bar 'gyur ba mthong / /de rnams kyis ni rtogs pa dang / /spyan ldan rnam par dpyad nas ni/ /de phyir ston pa yis 1)ni bos/ /bstan la dga' ba'i nyan thos kyis/ / lha yil snatshogs rnams 'ongs nas ni/ /dge slong rnams kyis de shes bya/ /gang zhig la ni bdag bshad bya/ /go rims bzhin⑧du mnyan par gyis/ /stong phrag bdun gyi gnod sbyin rnams/ /ser skya'i sa la gnas pa ni④ / /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog dang ni grags par ldan/ /chos gtam bya phyir 'dir 'ongs te/ /zhi bas dge slong tshal du'o/ /stong phrag drug ni gangs can gyi/ /gnod sbyin kha dog sna tshogs lus/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog dang ni grags par ldan/ /chos gtam bya phyir 'dir 45)'ongs te/ /zhi bas〈6)dge slong tshal du'o/ /sna tshogs bshes gnyen lnga brgya po/ /gnod sbyin kha dog sna tshogs lus/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan / /kha dog dang ni grags par ldan/ /chos gtam bya phyir 'dir 'ongs te/ /zhi bas dge slong tshal du'o/ /rgyal khab gnod sbyin chu srin ni/ /ngos yangs ri la gnas pa yin/ /stobs ldan 'bum phrag gcig po ni/ /gnod sbyin rnams kyi 'khor gyis bskor/ /rgyal khab gnod sbyin chu srin ni/ /zhi bas dge slong tshal du'o/ /shar gyi 3phyogs kyi dur rgyal po ni/ /ming ni yul 'khor srung zhes bsti / /dri za rnams kyi bdag po ste/ /rgyal po chen po grags chen ldan/ /de yi bu ni mang po rnams/ /ming ni gcig tu thos pa ste/ /dbang po zhes bya stobs chen po/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog dang ni grags par ldan//chos gtam hu )bya phyir 'dir nyu1'ongs te/ /zhi bas dge slong tshal du'o/ / lho yi phyogs kyi'ang lha rgyal po ni/ /ming ni 'phags skyes po zhes bya/ /grul bumamanye34—756

rnams kyi bdag po ste/ /rgyal po chen po grags chen ldan/ /de yi bu ni mang po rnams / /ming ni gcig tu thos pa ste/ /dbang po zhes bya stobs chen po/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog dang ni grags par ldan/ /chos gtam bya phyir 'dir 'ongs te/ /zhi bas dge slong tshal du'o/ /nub kyi phyogs kyi rgyal po ni/ /ming ni mig mi bzang zhes grags/ /klu rnams kyi ni bdag po ste / /rgyal po chen po grags chen ldan/ /de yi bu ni mang po rnams/ /ming ni gcig tu thos pa ste/ /dbang po zhes bya stobs dang ldan/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing stobs dang ldan/ /kha dog dang ni grags par ldan/ /chos gtam bya phyir 'dir 'ongs te/ /zhi bas dge slong tshal0)du'o/ /byang gi phyogs kyi rgyal po ni/ /de ming lus ngan po zhes grags/ /gnod sbyin rnams kyi bdag po ste/ /rgyal po chen po grags chen ldan/ /de yi bu ni mang po rnams/ /ming ni gcig tu thos pa ste/ /dbang po zhes bya stobs chen po/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog⑧dang ni grags par ldan/ /chos gtam bya phyir 'dir 'ongs te/ /zhi bas dge slong tshal du'o/ /shar phyogs na ni yul 'khor skyong / /lho phyogs na ni 'phags skyes pog/ /nub phyogs na ni mig mi bzang / /byang phyogs na ni lus ngan po/ /de rnams rgyal po chen posabazhi/ /phyogs rnams bzhi po kun du'o/ /gzi brjid 'bar bas 'khod nas 5nyeni/ /ser skya'i gzhi yi 45tshal du'o/ /de rnams sgyu ma rtsed mo bsam37/ /drung ldan rnams ni nam mkhar 1)'khod/ /sgyu ma sku ṭi (be+e ḍa 66) / /bir+ya ts+tsha bir+ya ḍo 31bcas/ /tsan da na dang nyu2'dod mchog dang / /mgul nyusnyepa mdzes dang mgul nges dang / /skye dgu'i bla mar gyur pa dang / /lha las byung ba'i kha lo pa/ /dri za sna tshogs sde dang ni/ /mi 31—757

rgyal rgyal7ba'i khyu mchog dang / /mdun du rtsesamo lnga de bzhin/ /g.yer ma dang ni nyi zer dang / /de dang gzhan gyi rgyal po rnams/ /rgyal po dri za dang bcas dang / /chos gtam bya phyir 'dir 'ongs nas/ /zhi bas dge slong tshal du'ol/ /de nas gzhan yang nam mkha'i klus/ /yangs pa can du lhan cig gnas( ciril/ /la ba rta yi mchog dang ni/ /rab 'gro gnyen dang lhan cig pa/ /ya mu na dang yul 'khor skyong / /klu yi spun5shedang grags ldan dang / /sa srungakyiglang po chen po rnams/ /de yang nags kyi tshal du'o/ /gang zhig klu rgyal myur du len / /lha dang bya dang rnam dag mig⑦ /nam mkha' las 'ongs tshal der sleb//sna tshogs 'dab bzangs ces7de'i ming / /'jigs med byin pas klu yi rgyal/ /mkha' lding bzod pa rtogs pas so/ /phan tshun du ni mi rtsod7cing / /klu khyung sangs rgyas skyabs 'gro ba/ /rdo rje lag rtsi )gis rgyal ba dang / /lha ma yin ni rgya mtshor gnas/ / spun rnams〈tshede yi gnas dang ni/ /gzi brjid ldan zhing grags dang ldan/ /nag po mig sman 'jigs byed ldan/ /lha ma yin rnams khro byed dang / / thags bzangs hunyedang ni thags bzangs risatso mtshan 'joms na mo tsi bedang bcas/ /stobs kyi bu ni brgyadakyipo rnams/ /thams cad rnam par snang mdzad mingarwa 1/ /stobs kyi sde ni go bgos pa/ /sgra gcanatsobazang po sngon /mdu 'gro/ /btsunasngo )pa de ni 'dus nas ni/ /zhi bas dge slong tshal du'o/ /chu dang lha dang sa dang0)ni/ /me dang rlung nyeyang der 'ongs so/ /chu lha chu yi lha dang ni/ /zla ba dang ni grags par ldan/ /byams dang snying rje'i tshogs can dang / /lha ni grags ldan mdun du'o/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten tshogs rnams ni/ /thams cad kha dog sna tshogs lus/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 34—758

'od dang ldan/ /kha dog dang ni grags par ldan/ /chos gtam bya phyir 'dir 'ongs te/ /zhi bas dge slong tshal du'o/ /khyab 'jug lha dang lhan cig tu/ / tha dad tha7dad 'ongs pa dang / /zla ba de yi 'khor gyi lha/ /zla ba'i mdun byas 'khor dang ni/ /nyi ma'i 'khor gyi lha rnams dang / /nyi ma'i mdun byas 'khor dang ni/ /rgyu skar de yi 'khor dang yang / /mdun byas pa la ha ka dang //sa dang sa yi gtso bo dang / /brgya byin yang7yang sbyin pa dang / /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten tshogs rnams dang / /thams cad kha dog sna tshogs lus/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog dang ni grags par ldan/ /chos gtam bya phyir 'dir 'ongs te/ /zhi bas dge slong tshal du'o/ /de nas nyerashespyod lha dang ni/ /chu dang me yi rtse mo bzhin/ /sgra ldan snang bar byed pa dang / /u ma'i me tog de bzhin du/ /chu lha dang bcas chos dang ni/ /atshu9ta dang du ma rnams/ /bzang len mdzes pa'i mdun dang ni/ /mdun dngasnyiganas dang du ma dang / /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten tshogs dang ni/ /thams cad kha dog sna tshogs lus/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog dang ni grags par ldan / /chos gtam bya phyir 'dir 'ongs te/ /zhi bas dge slong tshal du'o/ /'dus dang 'dus pa chen po ni/ /mi dang mi yi mchog dang ni/ /rol pa'i go 'phang mdun du dang / /yid mchog dang ni go 'phang rtse/ /de nas lha yi7mchod 'os dang / /gang yang dmar po'i gos gyon dang / /pha rol pha rol son chen dang / /grags chen lha yi mdunasheganas dang / /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten tshogs dang ni/ /thams cad kha dog sna tshogs lus/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog dang ni〈grags par ldan/ /chos gtam bya phyir 34—759

'dir 'ongs te/ /zhi bas dge slong tshal du'o/ /dkar dang drod dngashedamar po dang / /sngon shugs stugashepo lhan cig dang / /dkar po 'dzin pa la sogs dngang / /mkhas pa'i lha ni sngon du'o/ /rtag tu glang chen myos 'phrang ba/ /'dres pa grags dang ldan pa dang / /mtshun ④mang po mdun du dang / /gang zhig phyogs ni mdzes pa dang / /phyogs bcu'i⑧'jig rten tshogs rnams dang / /thams cad kha dog sna tshogs lus/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog dang ni grags par ldan/ /chos gtam stso)bya phyir 'dir 'ongs te/ /zhi bas dge slong tshal du'o/ /dge ba dga' ldan 'thabasamabral dang / /grags ldan shing〈shedang ldan pa dang / /'phyang ba gnas dang gtso bo dang / /'od dang bsam pa zhes bya dang / /6)'phrul dga' ba ni sngon huX du dang / /de nas gzhan 'phrul dbang byed sngon31/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten tshogs dang ni/ /thams cad kha dog sna tshogs lus/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /chos gtam bya phyir 'dir 'ongs nasanyuge/ /zhi bas dge slong tshal du'o/ /sna tshogs drug po'i sde pa ni / /thams cad kha dog sna tshogs lus/ /ming ni grags dang ldan pa sngon(snye/ /khang gegazhan 'dra ba lhan cig tu/ /ma lus rigs ni brjod pa dang / /zag med tshogs ni pha rol brgala'i/ /glang chen tshogs ni blta ba dang / /zla ba bzhad pa gsum ldan dang / /tshangs bzang hu'amachog gi thob pa dang / /rdzu 'phrul ldan pa'i bu dang ni/ /tsho de yi dga' ba'i gzhon nu nyusnyeni/ /de rnams zhi bas tshal du'o/ /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten stong du ni/ /tshangs pa chen po nye bar 'khodal/ /'od dang ldan par skye ba hurtedang / /grags ldan sna tshogs lus dang ni//dbang phyug bcu po sngon du dang / /so so dbang du gyur zhu ripa dang / /de yi 34—760

dbus dang sngon du dang / /'phrog ma 'khor dang bcas pa'o/ /de rnams thams cad 'ongs gyur nas/ /dbang po lha dang tshangs bcas hu)'ongs/ /bdud kyi sde rnams ge'ongs nas ni/ /go tam thugs ni blta ba dang / /'di ni zung shig⑧mings shig brjod/ /chags pa glang po bcings pa bzhin/ /'khor dang bcas pas bskor nas ni/ /gang du'ang stong pasnyim yin no/ /de la 'di ni bde chen dang / /gotshabatam sde la gnod mi nus/ /lag pa thal mo debs77pa dang ske/ /'jigs par byed pa'i cho nge sgrogs/ /ji ltar rlung gis57)sprin rnams dang ske/ /mun nag glog dang bcas pa ni/ /de ma thag tu 'jigs dang bral/ /bsam pa khro ba med par gnas/ /lha de rnams thams cad dang tshangs pas bcom ldan 'das la phyag byas te bskor ba byas nas de nyid du mi snang bar gyuras3)to / /bdud kyi sde de rnams tho )kyang cang mi smra ba'i tshul gyis song ngo / /ston pas nyan thos bstan pa la dga' ba rnams bos te/ de yang 'jigs pa med byed dang / /dag pa'i sangs rgyas bstan pa la/ /'jigs med 'dod chags bral ba ni/ /de yi ba spu'ang tsho/nyagayo ba med/ /g.yul ni kun las rgyal ba dang / /'jigs pa 'das shing grags par ldan/ /lha dang lhan cig brjod pa dang / /nyan thos rnams ni der 32gnas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong de rnams bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //'dus pa chen po'i mdo rdzogs stonya༄// // ripaṇ+ḍi ta ā nan+da shrī'i zhal snga nas mang du thos pa'i lo tsā 〉ba shākya'i dge slong nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ skad gnyis smra ba rnams kyi gdan sa/34—761
